jobs.title: Cambridge Information Group Inc: Front-End Developer
jobs.description:
Headquarters: New York, NY
URL: https://edconic.com/

Job Title: Front-End Developer
Location: Fully Remote (US)
Department: Global Enrollment Marketing and Sales
Reports to: Director of Web Development
Classification: Regular, Full-time
FLSA Status: Exempt
Prepared by: Global Head of Creative
Prepared Date: 10/1/26
Salary range: $85,000–$100,000


About Edconic

Edconic is a leading player in the alternative, experiential education space. We partner with the world's largest and most well-known brands to create and run schools that capture the legacy and value of each brand. Our students get truly unique, once-in-a-lifetime experiences that help shape their future and give them the skills they need to reach their goals.

Our Mission:

Edconic exists to help learners stand out, move forward, and build meaningful futures in the fields that inspire them. We bring together education and industry, partnering with iconic global organizations to create transformative learning experiences. Our programs are created and delivered by educators and industry practitioners, giving learners access to professional experts, real world challenges, and practical skills. As early career opportunities shrink, we offer credibility, connections, and hands on experience that internships once provided. We prepare learners not simply for their first job but for a lifetime of growth. 

Our values

• Transformative education: relationship-rich, experiential learning that draws out each learner’s potential.

• Belonging: a community where learners, educators, experts, and staff can bring their authentic selves and support one another.

• Stewardship: as a family-owned organization, we think in generations, developing talent, caring for our partnerships, and building an impact that lasts.

The Role

We're looking for an experienced Front-End Developer to join our web team, which owns every Edconic digital property – from our school websites to landing pages and email templates. You'll work alongside designers, IT, and MarTech to build solutions that serve real business needs while protecting each brand's unique identity.

You'll be one of two developers on the team, working directly with our lead developer. That means real ownership of your work, a genuine voice in how we build, very little process overhead, and a codebase that is actively moving toward a modern, standardized WordPress stack. We value craft: fast pages and code that the next developer can read.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain public-facing websites, micro-sites, and landing pages in collaboration with our lead developer, IT, and MarTech.
  • Work with UX/UI designers to confirm the technical feasibility of designs, then translate them into polished, responsive pages that stay true to each brand.
  • Build and maintain custom WordPress themes across both of our stacks: modern block-based builds (ACF Blocks, core blocks, block patterns, theme.json) and established classic themes built on PHP templates, Advanced Custom Fields, and Sass.
  • Collaborate with our lead developer to shape the team's coding standards, tooling, and workflow, and help migrate our existing sites toward our new modern stack.
  • Stay current on emerging web standards and bring ideas to the table where they genuinely fit.

What You Bring

  • 4+ years of front-end web development experience, with strong skills in semantic HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, and WordPress.
  • The ability to build a custom WordPress theme from scratch using PHP templates and Advanced Custom Fields.
  • Strong CSS skills across Sass and modern native CSS (custom properties, nesting), and solid vanilla JavaScript.
  • Comfort working in Git/GitHub with pull requests and code reviews, and with npm-based build tools and the command line.
  • A habit of writing semantic, well-structured HTML that covers accessibility basics, with an eye for reuse, cross-browser compatibility, performance, and SEO.
  • Experience building and testing HTML emails.
  • Strong UX/UI sensibilities and a desire to sweat the small stuff.
  • A proactive, self-directed working style – you can run with a project independently and prioritize across several at once.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication – you're positive, collaborative, objective, and solution-oriented.

Bonus Experience

  • Modern WordPress block development: ACF Blocks, block.json, theme.json, and block patterns.
  • Composer, Bedrock or other Roots tooling (Sage/Blade, Trellis), Vite, or CI/CD with GitHub Actions.
  • Deeper accessibility experience (WCAG, ARIA, assistive-technology testing).
  • CRM and marketing automation integration (Salesforce, Pardot/Account Engagement).
  • Multilingual WordPress sites.
  • A modern JavaScript framework such as React or Vue.
  • UX or UI design, and design tools such as Figma and Adobe Creative Suite.


How We Use AI

AI-assisted development is a new and evolving part of our workflow. We use AI coding tools to speed up research, scaffolding, review, and routine work, and you're welcome to do the same.

AI is a tool here, not a substitute for expertise. You are accountable for every line of code that you ship, which means you must be able to write, review, debug, and explain production code entirely on your own. Expect to demonstrate those skills without AI assistance during the interview process.

Location, Travel & Eligibility

  • Fully remote within the United States. Occasional travel to our New York office may be required.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the US.
  • Bachelor's degree preferred (Computer Science, Interaction Design, Graphic Design, Communications, or a related field); equivalent professional experience is equally welcome.

Our Commitment

Edconic supports and embraces diversity and inclusiveness, and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply, even if you don't meet every requirement listed here. Reasonable accommodations are available to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role and to participate in the interview process.

The above statements describe the general nature and level of work for this position. They are not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills. Edconic reserves the right to modify this job description at its sole discretion.

jobs.title: SimpleTiger: Web Developer: WordPress & HubSpot (U.S. Based, Remote Contractor)
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Sarasota, FL
URL: https://www.simpletiger.com/

SimpleTiger is hiring a part-time contract web developer to build, improve, and troubleshoot client websites in WordPress and HubSpot, with the potential to grow into a larger role.

We’re a B2B SaaS marketing agency helping software companies grow through SEO, content marketing, paid media, and answer engine optimization (AEO). Our clients’ websites are where much of that work comes to life, and we’re looking for a developer who can turn ideas into clean, functional pages quickly.

As part of our delivery team, you’ll work primarily on client websites, translating designs, campaign concepts, and SEO recommendations into effective web experiences. From building new pages to fixing issues on existing sites, you’ll help turn our marketing strategy into work that’s ready to launch.

Key responsibilities

  • Build, update, or troubleshoot client websites in WordPress and HubSpot CMS
  • Make technical fixes and improvements to live client sites, with clear details on what was tested, implemented, and performance comparisons using tools like Screaming Frog, pagespeed insights, and Lighthouse
  • Build and connect forms, lead routing, and simple automations between a site and the client’s marketing tools
  • Set up and check tracking, like GA4, Google Tag Manager, and HubSpot tracking in Tandem with the SEO Manager
  • Keep sites fast, accessible, and friendly to SEO (page speed, Core Web Vitals, clean markup, image optimizations, cache lifetime improvements, and so on)
  • Write clear and timely notes on what you are actively working on, and any updates pushed live so our team and the client can follow along

Qualifications and skills

  • You’re a hands-on developer who can build from scratch, troubleshoot existing sites, and make improvements without disrupting what’s already working.

Required skills

  • WordPress development: Strong experience with custom themes, child themes, blocks, page builders, and Advanced Custom Fields (ACF). You can build a page from the ground up—not just edit an existing one.
  • HubSpot CMS development: Strong experience with HubL templates, modules, and themes, including building and troubleshooting pages, forms, and email templates.
  • Front-end development: Solid HTML, CSS, and JavaScript skills, with the ability to navigate existing code and understand how changes affect the live site.
  • APIs and integrations: Experience working with the HubSpot or WordPress REST APIs, plus CRMs and marketing tools such as Salesforce, Zapier, n8n, Airtable, and Slack.
  • Technical audits and fixes: Experience using Screaming Frog to audit WordPress and HubSpot sites, interpret findings, and resolve technical issues.
  • Code review and cleanup: Comfort working within WordPress and HubSpot codebases to identify legacy or unused JavaScript and CSS, determine what’s still needed, and safely remove what isn’t.
  • Async communication: Clear, timely written communication, especially through Slack.
  • Independent work: Strong time management and the ability to meet deadlines, flag blockers early, and keep projects moving without close supervision.

Nice-to-have skills

  • Webflow development and auditing experience, including building a clean CMS structure.
  • PHP development experience.
  • Previous work at a marketing agency or with B2B SaaS clients.
  • Familiarity with SEO and conversion best practices.
  • Experience with Git and version control.

What success looks like

Success means delivering clean, reliable development work that helps our team turn marketing plans into live client experiences.

  • Designs, campaign concepts, and SEO requests become functional pages in WordPress and HubSpot.
  • Technical audit findings lead to practical fixes, with changes tested to avoid breaking existing functionality.
  • Legacy and unused code is cleaned up thoughtfully, while essential code and front-end behavior remain intact.
  • Forms, templates, and integrations work as intended and support the client’s marketing workflows.
  • Projects stay on track because you manage your workload, meet agreed deadlines, and raise questions or blockers early.
  • Teammates have clear visibility into progress through timely updates and straightforward communication in Slack.

jobs.title: UMA Education: Director of Career Services
jobs.description:
Headquarters:
URL: https://ultimatemedical.edu

Ultimate Medical Academy is a non-profit healthcare educational institution with a national presence. Headquartered in Tampa, Florida and founded in 1994, UMA offers content-rich, interactive online programs as well as hands-on training at our Clearwater, Florida campus. 

As a full-time team member, you will have access to the following benefits:

  • Medical (including prescription), Dental, Vision (UMA subsidized)
  • FSA/HSA (Depending on Medical Plan chosen)
  • Basic Life Insurance (UMA paid)
  • Additional Voluntary Life Insurance (Team Member paid)
  • Employee Assistance Program – EAP (UMA paid)
  • Long Term Disability (UMA paid)
  • Short Term Disability (Team Member paid)
  • Supplemental Insurance such as Critical Illness, Accident, and Hospital (Team Member Paid)
  • Paid Time Off – 15 days accrued in year 1, 9 holidays, and 1 day of Volunteering Time Off
  • 401k (eligible upon completion of 90 days of employment and must be at least 18 years of age)
  • Pet Insurance
  • Identity Theft Protection

Purpose of the Position:

The Director of Career Services provides strategic leadership and oversight for graduate placement initiatives, ensuring alignment with institutional goals and industry demands. This role drives performance across the Career Services team, fosters cross-functional collaboration with Corporate Alliance and Graduate Success teams, and supports business development efforts to enhance employment outcomes and partnerships.

What you’ll do:  

  1. Strategic Planning and Execution: Develop and implement strategic plans to achieve graduate employment goals, ensuring alignment with institutional objectives and market demands.
  2. Team Development and Performance: Oversee training, coaching, and performance of Career Services staff, including managers, to build a high-performing and engaged team.
  3. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Corporate Alliance, Graduate Success, and Education teams to support advisory boards, drive business development, and enhance placement outcomes.
  4. Team Member Engagement and Opportunity Creation: Establish and maintain systems to identify employment opportunities, while cultivating relationships with employers to expand graduate job prospects.
  5. Graduate Support and Career Readiness: Provide career coaching and job readiness support to graduates, including interview preparation and guidance for securing employment in their field of study.
  6. Compliance and Institutional Alignment: Ensure departmental compliance with regulatory and accreditation standards, while contributing to cross-departmental initiatives and institutional goals.
  7. Lead with Care: Lead, coach, and develop team members, fostering a culture of wellness, recognition, and engagement. Meet regularly with direct reports in one-on-one and group settings to provide feedback and cultivate/maintain a positive work culture. 
  8. Perform other duties as assigned. 

Career Level Expectations:

  • Typically manages multiple teams or a department. 
  • Requires a high degree of responsibility for resources and frequently influences business decisions made by functional leadership. 
  • Owns short to mid-term (1-3 years) strategy, execution and operational direction for multiple departments which directly impacts the achievement of overall functional results. 
  • Problems faced are frequently complex and require extensive investigation and analysis in collaboration with others. 
  • Requires the ability to influence others to accept practices and approaches, and ability to communicate with executive leadership. 
  • Desire for growth and professional development. 

Required Skills/Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 5 years of experience in recruiting, career services and employment assistance, or in sales.
  • Ability to professionally communicate fluently in verbal and written English.
  • Ability to contribute to a diverse and inclusive work environment.
  • Computer literacy/basic computer skills to effectively navigate and utilize the technology required for the role.

Preferred Requirements:

  • Director level experience.
  • Strong analytical skill set.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and other business tools such as Microsoft Teams.

Compliance: 

  • Demonstrate knowledge of and carefully follow all applicable federal and state compliance requirements and regulations including those prescribed by the U.S. Department of Education, accrediting agencies, state regulations, and internal policies and procedures.   
  • Effectively communicate compliance requirements to other staff as appropriate and quickly escalate any compliance concerns to the Compliance department.

Work Environment/Physical Demands: 

  • This is a remote position.
  • Home office set up, quiet place to work, and ability to hard wire into high-speed internet connection.
  • May require setup of computer equipment; accommodation consideration available upon request.
  • Flexibility to work evenings and weekends, as needed. 

In addition to the compensation listed below, this position includes a cell phone allowance and eligibility for an annual incentive bonus.

Compensation Range
$100,000—$100,000 USD

OUR VALUES

Our institutional values are shaped and validated by our team members. They describe how we strive to operate and are the standards of behavior we look to embody. 

ACT WITH INTEGRITY

We operate honestly and ethically in an industry-compliant fashion. We are fair and trustworthy in our interactions with all we serve. Our team members, at all levels, lead by example and strive to do the right thing for our students and for each other. We are disciplined professionals who strive to be straightforward and dependable.

CHAMPION STUDENT OUTCOMES

We live by a strong commitment to our students and are passionate about preparing them for meaningful careers. We are deeply dedicated to ensuring students’ educational and career success. We excel at building our students’ confidence and empowering them to reach their full potential.

COMMIT TO TEAM MEMBER SUCCESS

We are committed to our team members’ success and to each other’s success. We strive to create an environment that attracts and retains the best talent while offering continuous learning, professional development and career growth opportunities. We recognize and reward our team members for their contributions to the organization and to our students.

PURSUE RESULTS WITH PURPOSE

We pursue results with a sense of urgency and purpose. We take responsibility for achieving ambitious, measurable results and hold each other accountable. We think strategically and critically, greet new ideas and challenges openly, and look for innovative solutions to challenges.

HAVE FUN. BUILD ENERGY

Enjoying what we do is central to achieving our goals. Building energy, having fun, being optimistic and creating a positive working environment are all critical to our success and that of our students. We strive to be inspired and to inspire others. We consistently show appreciation and celebrate our successes, both large and small.

WORK AS ONE

We believe that diverse, inclusive teams produce breakthrough results. We strive to build and maintain positive relationships with colleagues from all types of backgrounds by showing respect and humility when interacting with each other and resolving conflicts in a constructive manner. By working together, we win together - as one - ensuring that the goals of the company are the focal point of our efforts.

UMA will NEVER ask you to send money or ask you to provide bank account information in order for you to get reimbursed for tools to work. If you have been contacted by someone claiming to be from UMA about a job posting, you can always verify the position at https://workatuma.com/

Targeted range for this role is $75,000 - $85,000 annually.

How We Determine What We Pay
As a fully remote employer, ALC determines pay for positions using national and industry-specific survey data. We evaluate external equity and the cost of labor/prevailing wage index in the relative marketplace for jobs directly comparable to jobs within our company. Our posted salary range is based on national data and may be refined for a candidate's region/town/cost of living.

For new hires, we strive to make competitive offers allowing the new employee room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position. An employee/candidate with a stronger skill set will receive higher pay.

jobs.title: Bitovi: Backend / Platform Developer Consultant (Temporal & Kubernetes)
jobs.description:
Headquarters: United States
URL: https://bitovi.com

JOIN OUR TEAM!

Bitovi is looking for a Backend / Platform Developer Consultant to join us as we transform technology delivery. We build and operate durable, distributed systems for enterprise clients — heavy on Java Services, Temporal for workflow orchestration, Kafka for event streaming, and Kubernetes-native platform engineering on AWS to run it all reliably. If you want to build exceptional systems, take orchestration, systems engineering, and infrastructure seriously, and have ideas for making delivery more collaborative, validation-driven, and swift, we want to work with you!

Compensation: $120,000 to $190,000 annually, depending on experience, plus annual bonus opportunity.

PLEASE NOTE: At this time, we are only considering candidates located in and authorized to work in the United States.

 

WHO YOU ARE

You're experienced building and running applications at the enterprise level, and you're comfortable owning both the code and the infrastructure it runs on. You think like a systems engineer — reasoning about the whole platform, from JVM services and event streams to the clusters and cloud infrastructure underneath them. You thrive when given opportunities to deliver real-world platforms as an integral team member, including large-scale migrations, and you have the expertise to interface and communicate confidently with stakeholders.

You'll excel in this role at Bitovi if you have:

  • Strong working knowledge of Java and the JVM ecosystem (Spring Boot or similar); experience with additional backend languages (Go, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, C#, etc.) is a plus
  • Hands-on experience with a durable execution / workflow engine — Temporal preferred (Apache Airflow, Prefect, or similar also relevant) — including modeling workflows and activities, handling retries and timeouts, and reasoning about idempotency and failure modes
  • Experience designing and operating Kafka-based event streaming systems: topic and partition design, consumer groups, schema management, and reasoning about ordering, delivery guarantees, and consumer lag
  • Experience designing and building GraphQL APIs — schema design, resolvers, and performance concerns (N+1, caching, pagination); federation experience a plus
  • Deep, hands-on AWS experience: architecting, deploying, and operating production systems (EKS, networking, IAM, messaging, and data services)
  • Solid Kubernetes experience: deploying, operating, and debugging production workloads
  • A systems engineering mindset: understanding of complex scaling issues, concurrency, backpressure, caching strategies, and failure modes across distributed systems
  • Experience planning and executing migrations — application replatforming, workflow engine migrations, data/schema migrations, or moving workloads between environments with minimal downtime
  • A thorough understanding of CI/CD pipelines and GitOps-style delivery
  • Experience with observability in practice — logging, metrics, and tracing (OpenTelemetry a plus)
  • Experience building modern microservice-based or serverless applications
  • Database schema design and development expertise

Other skills we value

Temporal depth

  • Running Temporal in production — self-hosted on Kubernetes and/or Temporal Cloud
  • Workflow versioning and patching, safe deployments, and long-running workflow migrations
  • Worker deployment and tuning (pollers, task queues, concurrency/slot configuration)
  • Namespace management, mTLS (SPIFFE/SPIRE or private CA), and capacity/scaling concerns (e.g. APS/TRU on Temporal Cloud

Kafka & event streaming depth

  • Operating Kafka in production (MSK, Confluent, or self-managed on Kubernetes)
  • Kafka Connect, Kafka Streams, and schema registry workflows (Avro/Protobuf)
  • Migrating between clusters or providers, and integrating Kafka with downstream analytical stores
  • Experience with different techniques for processing large datasets, such as Lambda and Kappa architectures

Platform / DevOps depth

  • Building or operating an internal developer platform (IDP) — self-service, paved-path infrastructure for application teams
  • GitOps with ArgoCD (or Flux) and a low- or zero-manual-apply delivery model
  • Infrastructure as code: Terraform/OpenTofu, and provisioning AWS resources via Crossplane, ACK, or similar
  • Writing Kubernetes controllers/operators (controller-runtime, kubebuilder) and working with CRDs
  • Helm chart authoring and distribution (including OCI/registry-based)
  • Secrets management (External Secrets Operator, etc.), autoscaling (Karpenter, KEDA), and service mesh concepts (Istio, SPIFFE/SPIRE)
  • EKS or comparable managed Kubernetes at scale

General

  • Interest in working across multiple backend languages
  • Additional queueing and messaging technologies (AWS SQS/SNS, RabbitMQ)
  • API design across paradigms (GraphQL, REST, gRPC)
  • AuthN/AuthZ and related technologies (sessions, API tokens, JWTs)
  • Automated testing across the stack (unit, integration, performance/benchmarking)

WHO WE ARE

Bitovi partners with companies to build outcome-focused apps and platforms. Our collaborative approach is driven by validation to deliver the swiftest route to the most valuable solution.

We design and build high-profile applications and the infrastructure behind them — with tests, full docs, and a real deployment process. We run a serious Temporal practice (including large-scale migration and security work for enterprise clients) alongside deep Kubernetes, AWS, and platform engineering work. We discuss and design architectures, review code, and research new technologies. We talk to our clients, guiding them through the process, identifying potential problems and unknowns, and tackling challenges.

We help one another freely. We keep a Slack channel called ask-help, which is constantly used. We develop new skills, build better developer tools, and work on new types of projects regularly.

Our fully remote team comprises about 70 developers and designers. We welcome diversity and non-traditional paths into professions — we want the right person, not the right collection of tech keywords.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO AT BITOVI

Build durable systems. Design and implement Java services, Temporal workflows, and Kafka-based event pipelines, and help clients adopt durable execution and event streaming the right way — from first workflow to production scale.

Lead modernization efforts. Plan and execute large-scale modernization efforts — moving workflows, services, and data between platforms, clusters, and clouds — with safety, observability, and minimal disruption as first-class requirements.

Own the platform. Build and operate Kubernetes-native infrastructure and CI/CD on AWS so application teams can ship safely and quickly. Treat reliability, observability, and repeatability as part of the deliverable, not an afterthought.

Consult and manage. Consult with clients to build outcome-driven applications and platforms, guiding them through the process, identifying potential problems and unknowns, and tackling challenges.

Travel. This is a remote, full-time position that requires the ability to travel. We travel an average of 3–5 days every quarter, and we'll always do our best to work with your schedule.

Teach. We'll discuss opportunities for you to present at conferences, attend and give training, plan and run meetups or local groups, and create various kinds of content in your area of expertise.

 

BENEFITS WE OFFER

  • Competitive salary and annual bonus opportunity
  • Completely remote work with flexible hours
  • 401(k) matching
  • 4 weeks of paid time off in addition to 8 paid holidays
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance offerings
  • Paid maternity and paternity leave
  • STD, LTD, and Life Insurance coverage

 

HOW TO APPLY

Please share a resume or LinkedIn profile and answer the additional questions via the application link. 

 

OTHER

jobs.title: Legion: Senior Integration Engineer
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote, Mexico

Senior Integration Engineer

Remote, Mexico

JOB OVERVIEW

Are you passionate about building large-scale applications leveraging public cloud services and integration design patterns? As an Integration Engineer, you will work on developing and maintaining Integration & Automation Solutions for Legion WFM customers.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES

Integration Engineers provide leadership, facilitate analysis and design tasks, and support multiple Legion teams in developing an enterprise's solution architecture. Job responsibilities are grouped across four key areas: Technical Integrations, Customer-Centric Consulting, Legion Product Expertise, and a Commitment to One Another.

Please note this role involves participation in on-call rotation.

Technical Integrations

  • Design and implement scalable integration architectures connecting Legion with HR, POS, Payroll, and other enterprise systems.
  • Design, Build, and Test integrations using Workato
  • Develop secure and efficient REST APIs within Legion's API-driven ecosystem.
  • Ensure high-performance, reliable integrations using modern cloud platforms.
  • Engage with architects and engineers for design collaboration and code reviews.
  • Improve development practices and stay ahead of agile software engineering trends.

Legion Product Expertise

  • Gain and maintain deep knowledge of Legion's product and integration ecosystem.
  • Identify, report, and prioritize product bugs and enhancements.
  • Work with core engineering and production engineering teams to improve backend reliability and troubleshoot production issues
  • Stay updated on new releases and enhancements to drive product adoption.
  • Write secure, enterprise-grade integration code using leading platforms and technologies.
  • Write well-designed, testable, efficient code
  • Contribute to all phases of the development lifecycle
  • Conduct peer code reviews to ensure code quality and maintainability.

Team Collaboration & Mentorship

  • Share expertise and mentor junior engineers, fostering a culture of knowledge-sharing.
  • Contribute to best practices for integration and internal technical documentation.
  • Support process improvements and advocate for scalable, sustainable integrations.
  • Commit to high-quality work, setting personal and team objectives aligned with organizational goals.
  • Standard shift working hours: 0900-1800
  • This role involves participation in on-call rotation.
  • This role may require work outside of normal business hours.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • 7+ years of business/information/solution/technical architecture experience
  • Graduate of a university with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant STEM field, including Information Systems, Engineering, Computer Science, or another relevant degree
  • Must be able to work as a team player, yet can work independently.
  • Analytical, results-driven, and have a solution-oriented approach
  • Possess exceptional interpersonal and English communication skills, including verbal, written presentation, and listening.
  • 3+ years of experience with event-driven Architecture and Microservices
  • Demonstrated deep technical expertise in Integration technologies and protocols such as HTTP, HTTPS, FTP, SFTP, SOAP, REST, JMS, JDBC
  • Experience using Linux/Unix environments
  • Demonstrate proficiency with Core Java.
  • Experience with Relational Databases, SQL and JDBC (one of Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, etc.)
  • 2+ years of experience using AWS technologies such as AWS CDK, Cloud formation, S3, ECS, EKS, and EC2
  • Demonstrate experience with test-driven development.
  • Strong experience with Java/RESTful web services
  • Exposure to agile software development leveraging toolsets (e.g., Jira, GitHub, Jenkins)
  • Demonstrate knowledge and experience with CI/CD processes and tools.
  • Proven track record of using problem-solving / root-cause analysis

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS AND ATTRIBUTES

  • The ideal candidate has workforce management integration experience
  • Preferred experience in the design and implementation of scalable integration solutions with integration platforms such as Workato, SAP BTP Integration Suite, Dell Boomi, Jitterbit, SnapLogic 
  • Proactive and able to command respect through intelligence, hard work, and persistence
  • Technical consulting experience.
  • Experience of working with Docker and other isolation technologies.
  • Experience working with external applications integrations end-to-end such as Workday, SAP, etc.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a fully remote employer, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry-specific survey data. 

We strive to make competitive offers allowing employees room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position. 

Benefits include, but are not limited to: 

  • Health Benefits
  • Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
  • Parental Leave 
  • Equity 
  • Monthly Wellness Reimbursement
  • Monthly Lunch on Legion

ABOUT LEGION

Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a remote, mission-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission. Legion Technologies delivers the industry’s most innovative workforce management platform. It enables businesses to maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously. The award-winning, AI-driven Legion WFM platform is intelligent, automated, and employee-centric. It’s proven to deliver 13x ROI through schedule optimization, reduced attrition, increased productivity, and increased operational efficiency. Legion delivers cutting-edge technology in an easy-to-use platform and mobile app that employees love. 

If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling.

BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY 

There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3,200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options. Legion’s mission is to turn hourly jobs into good jobs, serving the hourly workers who make up the majority of the US workforce. We believe in empowering employees and helping employers be efficient and innovative by enabling intelligent automation powered by Legion’s Workforce Management platform to optimize labor efficiency and enhance the employee experience simultaneously. Legion WFM was built for the cloud with AI at the core and designed to handle the complexity of modern businesses and meet the needs of today’s hourly employees.  Our team is comprised of dedicated individuals from all backgrounds and experiences, globally distributed across all time zones.

For more information, visit https://legion.co 

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

Legion Technologies is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, marital status, familial status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, genetic information, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, veteran status, and any other legally protected status under federal, state, or local anti-discrimination laws.

DISABILITY ACCOMMODATION

For individuals with disabilities who need additional assistance at any point in the application and interview process, please email recruiting@legion.co 

We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Legion recruiting email communications will always come from the @legion.co domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Legion via other sources should be ignored. If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official Legion employee, reach out to recruiting@legion.co

 

Legion is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, religion, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, veteran, disability status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

How We Determine What We Pay

As a global employer, Legion determines pay for positions using local, national, and industry-specific survey data. We evaluate external equity and the cost of labor/prevailing wage index in the relative marketplace for jobs directly comparable to jobs within our company. Our posted salary range is based on national data and may be refined for a candidate's region/town/cost of living. For new hires, we strive to make competitive offers allowing the new employee room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position. An employee/candidate with a stronger skill set will receive higher pay.

Job Applicant Privacy Policy

This Job Applicant Privacy Policy (“Policy”) describes how Legion Technologies, Inc. (“Legion”, “we”, “us” and “our”) collects, uses, and discloses “personal information” as defined under California law from and about job applicants who are residents of California.

This Policy does not apply to our handling of data gathered about you in your role as a user of our consumer-facing services. When you interact with us as in that role, the Legion Privacy Policy applies.

  1. Types of Personal Information We Handle

    We collect, store, and use various types of personal information through the application and recruitment process. We collect such information either directly from you or (where applicable) from another person or entity, such as an employment agency or consultancy, background check provider, or other referral sources. This information includes:

    • Identification and contact information, and related identifiers such as full name, date and place of birth, citizenship and permanent residence, home and business addresses, telephone numbers, email addresses, and such information about your beneficiaries or emergency contacts.
    • Professional or employment-related information, including:
      • Recruitment, employment, or engagement information such as application forms and information included in a resume, cover letter, or otherwise provided through any application or engagement process; and copies of identification documents, such as driver’s licenses, passports, and visas; and background screening results and references.
      • Career information such as job titles; work history; work dates and work locations; information about skills, qualifications, experience, publications, speaking engagements, and preferences; and professional memberships
    • Education Information such as institutions attended, degrees, certifications, training courses, publications, and transcript information.
    • Legally protected classification information such as race, sex/gender, religious/ philosophical beliefs, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, marital status, military service, nationality, ethnicity, request for family care leave, political opinions, and criminal history.
    • Other information such as any information you voluntarily choose to provide in connection with your job application.

  2. How We Use Personal Information

    We collect, use, share, and store personal information from job applicants for our and our service providers’ business and operational purposes in the recruitment process such as: processing your application, tracking your application through the recruitment process, contacting references with your authorization, conducting background checks you authorize, and making hiring decisions. We will also use job applicant information for internal analysis purposes to understand the applicants who apply and to improve our recruitment process. We may sometimes need to use applicant information for legal purposes, such as in connection with any challenges made to our hiring decisions.

  3. With Whom We Share Personal Information

    • Internally: to other Legion personnel involved in the recruiting and hiring process.
    • Vendors: such as technology service providers, travel management providers, human resources suppliers, background check companies, and employment agencies or recruiters, where applicable.
    • Legal Compliance: when required to do so by law, regulation, or court order or in response to a request for assistance by the police or other law enforcement agency.
    • Litigation Purposes: to seek legal advice from our external lawyers or in connection with litigation with a third party.
    • Business Transaction Purposes: in connection with the sale, purchase, or merger.
  4. How to Contact Us About this Policy – If you have any questions about this Policy, please contact privacy@legion.co.

jobs.title: Airbnb: Senior Data Engineer Tech Foundations
jobs.description:
Headquarters: US - Remote

Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

Senior Data Engineer, Enterprise Core Datasets, Tech Foundations

The Community You Will Join

At Airbnb, trustworthy data powers business decisions, product innovation, and operational efficiency. The Enterprise Core Datasets team builds the technical data foundations that help Airbnb understand how the business operates, where resources are invested, and how new technologies create value.

Our scope spans high-impact datasets across the organization: measuring AI adoption, usage, and cost; understanding revenue, costs, and profitability through Unit Economics; integrating non-platform data from Jira and other enterprise applications; and powering critical company metrics such as Gross Booking Value and Revenue.

You will join a team that values thoughtful architecture, engineering rigor, and operational ownership. We collaborate with engineering, product, analytics, finance, and business teams to turn complex requirements into dependable, reusable data assets. We welcome strong engineers who are curious about the business and eager to solve problems across diverse domains.

The Difference You Will Make

As a Senior Data Engineer, you will design, build, and operate datasets that shape decisions across Airbnb. Your work will help the organization measure AI adoption and spending, understand the economics of its products, and connect enterprise application data to meaningful business and operational insights.

You will own complex data engineering projects from requirements gathering and technical design through implementation, validation, and production operations. Working closely with stakeholders and engineering partners, you will build maintainable data models and pipelines that accommodate new AI tools, products, cost categories, and enterprise systems while preserving clear definitions, traceability, and reliable historical data.

Operating in an ecosystem that includes petabyte-scale datasets, you will improve correctness, freshness, performance, and cost efficiency. You will build reusable components that simplify source onboarding and reduce duplicated logic. Through design reviews, knowledge sharing, and mentorship, you will help strengthen the team’s engineering practices and contribute to Airbnb’s broader data community.

A Typical Day

  • Design, build, and operate high-impact data pipelines across AI usage and cost, Unit Economics, enterprise applications, and critical financial metrics.
  • Partner with stakeholders to clarify how AI adoption, consumption, and spending are measured, and implement consistent data models that support those definitions.
  • Evolve Unit Economics datasets to connect revenue and diverse cost drivers, enabling teams to understand product profitability and resource efficiency.
  • Build reliable ingestion and transformation pipelines for non-platform systems such as Jira and other BizTech enterprise applications.
  • Translate complex requirements into clear source contracts, reusable fact and dimension models, and practical technical designs.
  • Develop configurable pipelines and shared components that simplify onboarding new data sources, products, and business requirements.
  • Implement automated testing, reconciliation, anomaly detection, and monitoring to protect data accuracy, completeness, and availability.
  • Plan and execute safe migrations and historical backfills through dependency analysis, validation, controlled cutovers, and recovery planning.
  • Optimize distributed processing, storage, and query performance to improve freshness and reduce compute costs.
  • Own production reliability for your datasets and pipelines through on-call participation, incident response, and improvements to systems and runbooks.
  • Contribute to technical planning and design reviews, mentor fellow engineers, and improve Airbnb’s Data Engineering Paved Path.

Your Expertise

  • 5+ years of relevant industry experience, with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • A track record of independently delivering complex data engineering projects, from requirements and technical design through implementation and sustained production ownership.
  • Strong expertise in SQL and programming skills in Python or Scala, with experience building maintainable, well-tested data systems.
  • Hands-on experience with distributed processing technologies such as Apache Spark and large-scale analytical storage systems.
  • Strong data modeling skills, including fact and dimension design, slowly changing dimensions, incremental processing, and historical data management.
  • Experience integrating heterogeneous sources, including APIs, enterprise applications, event data, and transactional systems, while managing schema changes and source reliability.
  • Proven ability to build reliable pipelines and execute migrations and backfills while preserving correctness and downstream compatibility.
  • Experience implementing data quality controls, observability, lineage, and governance practices, and troubleshooting production data issues.
  • The ability to diagnose performance bottlenecks and optimize distributed computation, storage, and query execution.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, including the ability to clarify requirements with business partners, explain technical tradeoffs, and coordinate delivery across teams.
  • Experience contributing to design and code reviews, sharing knowledge, and supporting the development of other engineers.
  • Curiosity and sound judgment when learning new domains and balancing delivery needs with long-term system health.

Experience with AI usage or cost measurement, cloud cost attribution, Unit Economics, enterprise application data, or financial and payments datasets is a plus. Familiarity with workflow orchestration, SQL transformation frameworks, and modern table formats such as Apache Iceberg is also valuable.

Your Location

This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity. Click here for the up-to-date list of excluded states. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list. If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com. Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process. 

We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.

Equal Employment Opportunity:

Airbnb values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Airbnb are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, gender, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.

How We'll Take Care of You:

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.  

Pay Range
$196,000—$230,000 USD

 

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. jobs.title: 6sense: Business Solutions Partner - Enterprise AI
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Costa Rica, Remote

Our Mission:

6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency.  We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

Our People:

People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging.  Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology.  6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers.  We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career. 

Enterprise AI Business Solutions Partner

Business Solutions Partner — GTM & Finance Systems

Location
Costa Rica  

Function / Dept
Business Technology — Enterprise Applications

Reports to
Director, Enterprise Applications

Position Summary

6sense is seeking an Enterprise AI Business Solutions Partner to help transform how business functions leverage AI, automation, and enterprise technology to achieve their goals.

This role sits at the intersection of business consulting, AI solution design, automation engineering, and value realization. You will partner with teams across Go-to-Market, Customer Success, Support, Legal, Finance, and Partner Operations to identify opportunities where AI and automation can simplify work, improve user experiences, reduce costs, and accelerate business outcomes.

Unlike a traditional Business Systems Analyst or Business Solution Partner, this role is expected to move beyond requirements gathering. You will evaluate business processes, build proof-of-concepts, create AI agents, develop low-code automations, and validate business value before solutions are scaled into production. Working closely with the Enterprise AI Engineering team, you will translate complex business challenges into technical requirements and implementation plans while independently delivering design prototypes and lightweight solutions using platforms such as Microsoft Copilot, Claude, Workato, and other approved enterprise AI technologies.

A successful candidate combines strong business analysis skills with hands-on technical aptitude. They can engage stakeholders, map workflows, build basic automations, create AI-powered solutions, measure outcomes, and communicate recommendations to both business and technical audiences.

This is a growth role within a new Enterprise AI career track. You will work under the guidance of the Lead Enterprise AI Business Solutions Engineer and will be measured on business outcomes, including adoption, productivity gains, automation impact, cost avoidance, and process improvements. As you progress, you will take increasing ownership of a portfolio of business capabilities, including identifying, developing, delivering and maturing measurable AI-driven value.

Responsibilities

Tool Inventory & AI Efficiency Discovery

  • Build and maintain the AI and tool inventory for your assigned function: owner, use case, active users, annual cost, renewal date, AI features in use, contract exit terms and replacement feasibility.
  • Find where AI features we already pay for are unused, duplicated or overlap with other tools, and document the findings.
  • Track renewal dates and flag every contract at least 120 days before the notice date so a build-vs-buy decision can be made in time.
  • Run discovery interviews and working sessions with stakeholders to understand how work actually gets done, and surface the business problem behind the requested feature.
  • Map current processes and estimate the time spent, the number of people involved and the frequency, so every opportunity has a baseline.

Build-vs-Buy Analysis & Business Cases

  • Prepare the inputs for build-vs-buy analysis: what the tool does, how deeply it is integrated, compliance burden, usage compared with cost, and realistic replacement scope.
  • Contribute to business cases that compare three-year build, run and support cost with vendor cost, working with the Lead and with Enterprise AI Engineers on the build side.
  • Agree baselines with business owners before work starts and record their sign-off, so savings and hours returned can be validated later.
  • Recommend which candidates to pursue first, using renewal timing, savings potential and build feasibility.

Prototyping & Applied AI

  • Build prototypes and simple agents with Claude and Copilot to test whether a tool, or part of a workflow, can be replaced or improved.
  • Write clear, build-ready context for Enterprise AI Engineers: the process, the data involved, example inputs and outputs, acceptance criteria and edge cases.
  • Help define evaluation criteria, guardrails, human-in-the-loop checkpoints and escalation paths before anything reaches production.
  • Design the process around the AI: what changes for the seller, agent or analyst, what training is needed and how exceptions are handled.
  • Bring AI fluency to stakeholders: help non-technical teams understand what these tools can and cannot reliably do, and set realistic expectations.

Stakeholder Partnership

  • Serve as the named Business Solutions Partner for your assigned function, and the point of contact for intake, priorities and status.
  • Translate business needs into clear, buildable stories and acceptance criteria, and translate technical trade-offs back into language stakeholders can act on.
  • Keep stakeholders informed on what is changing, what is being built and what may move more slowly during the transition.
  • Escalate misalignment, scope drift and risk early to the Lead before they become executive issues.

Hands-On Salesforce & Delivery

  • Configure and deliver declarative Salesforce solutions (flows, validation rules, record types, page layouts, permission sets, reports and dashboards) for small requests, with guidance on larger ones.
  • Understand Apex, integrations and data model implications well enough to scope work accurately and hold a credible technical conversation with engineers.
  • Own UAT for your function: define test scenarios, coordinate stakeholder testing and support release sign-off.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of processes, solution designs and system dependencies.

Measurement & Ways of Working

  • Track adoption (percent of target users active) for anything shipped in your function, and report what is working and what should be retired.
  • Report hours returned and spend avoided using the agreed baseline, and flag figures that are not yet validated.
  • Work in the team’s agentic delivery model: use the intake agent, async standups and automated sprint summaries instead of status meetings, and give feedback on what to improve.
  • Contribute to team standards for the inventory, business case template and requirements.

Skills & Experience

Required

  • 2–4 years of relevant experience as a business analyst, business solution partner, business systems analyst, Salesforce administrator or operations analyst supporting business stakeholders, preferably at a SaaS company.

jobs.title: CircleCI: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Canada (Remote), United States (Remote), United Kingdom (Remote) Mexico City, Mexico - Hybrid

About CircleCI Engineering

CI/CD has been solved. Now it's being reinvented. AI agents don't just run pipelines. They write code, trigger builds, interpret failures, and propose fixes. The interfaces that developers use to understand and trust that work don't exist yet. We're building them.

At CircleCI, our guiding principles aren't posters on a wall. We learn fast: we run experiments, accept failure, and scale what works. We think like the customer: every decision connects back to the developer sitting in front of a failing build at 2 am. We own the outcome: not just our slice of it, but the whole thing. If that's how you already work, you'll fit here.

Team-Agnostic Placement

We don't hire for a team. We hire for CircleCI. Where you land depends on where your strengths create the most leverage, and we figure that out together. You might own the CI pipeline experience, deploy and release tooling, notification infrastructure, monetization flows, AI agent surfaces, or the foundational web platform. The through line across all of it is the same: full-stack ownership, a high bar for craft, and work that directly shapes how tens of thousands of developers experience CircleCI every day.

What You'll Do

  • Build AI-natively. AI is how we work. It's not a productivity layer on top of engineering, but the default starting point for how problems get approached and solved.
  • Own technical strategy for your domain. You decide when and how the architecture evolves, balancing technical debt against velocity. When a project spans teams, you're the one who breaks down the ambiguity and takes ownership of whether it lands.
  • Invent new interfaces. Software delivery is being reinvented. Pipelines run autonomously, generate fixes, and surface results that need human judgment. The tools developers use to understand, trust, and act on that work don't exist yet. You'll define what they look like and establish the patterns the team builds on.
  • Own the full stack, at scale. Build features end-to-end in Go, React, and TypeScript. Your ownership extends past your own code to the systems and teams around it.
  • Connect engineering to the business. Partner directly with Product and Engineering Management to translate business goals into technical strategy. You understand the "why" behind the roadmap and use it to make tradeoffs.
  • Champion observability. Drive monitoring and alerting strategy across your domain, not just your own services. Use Honeycomb, Datadog, and Rollbar to reduce noise and improve the org's ability to diagnose problems quickly.
  • Mentor at scale. Mentor multiple engineers at once. Build the systems and documentation that transfer knowledge and remove single points of failure, not just your own.

What You'll Bring

  • AI-native engineering practices. You use AI tools daily and can speak to what you've built, where they changed your approach, and where they fall short.
  • A track record of shipping at scale. You've built and owned systems that other engineers build on. 8+ years of production full-stack experience, with a history of taking accountability for outcomes.
  • Full-stack depth. Strong across the stack — React and TypeScript on the frontend, Go on the backend, owning API design, data modeling, and service integration.
  • System design, across domains. You own architecture decisions that span multiple systems and teams. You make the tradeoff calls, document the reasoning, and are the person others escalate to when the answer isn't obvious.
  • Business acumen. You understand how your domain connects to the broader business, and you use that context to guide technical decisions, not just implement them.
  • Technical leadership. You mentor engineers, give direct feedback on technical direction, and raise the quality bar across teams through how you engage in reviews and design discussions, not just what you ship.

Sound like you?

You've stopped waiting for AI to mature and are already building with it, not as a productivity trick, but as a core part of how you think about problems. You care about the product as much as the code. You're drawn to work where the patterns don't exist yet and the best answer requires you to invent it. If that's how you already operate, we want to talk.

About CircleCI

CircleCI is the world’s largest continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) platform, and the hub where code moves from idea to delivery. As one of the most-used DevOps tools - processing more than 3 million jobs a day - CircleCI has unique access to data on how the most effective engineering teams work, and the tools to help software companies successfully leverage the power of AI into their commercial applications. Companies like Hinge, HuggingFace, and Samsung use us to improve engineering team productivity, release better products, and get to market faster.


Founded in 2011 and headquartered in downtown San Francisco with a global, remote workforce, CircleCI is venture-backed by Base10, Greenspring Associates, Eleven Prime, IVP, Sapphire Ventures, Top Tier Capital Partners, Baseline Ventures, Threshold
Ventures, Scale Venture Partners, Owl Rock Capital, Next Equity Partners, Heavybit, and Harrison Metal Capital. 

CircleCI is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

How CircleCI Uses AI in Hiring

At CircleCI, people make our hiring decisions. We use technology to support our recruiting team so they can spend more time on what matters most: getting to know you.

Where we may use AI

  • Job descriptions and messaging: AI may help draft job descriptions and role-specific messaging so they are clear and accurate.
  • Application review: For some roles, we use an AI tool to review applications, including resumes and application responses, against criteria our hiring team sets for the role. The tool generates a fit score and summary to help recruiters organize and prioritize applications. 
  • Interview notes: With advance notice, an AI note-taking tool may join interviews to record, transcribe, and summarize the conversation. This lets interviewers focus on talking with you. You will be told before each interview, and you may opt out at any stage by letting your recruiter know. If you opt out, the tool will not join, and your candidacy is not affected.
  • Outreach: AI may help draft candidate outreach and scheduling messages, which our team reviews before sending.

Our commitment

AI does not make hiring decisions at CircleCI. Our recruiters and hiring teams review candidates and make every decision to advance or reject an application. No candidate is rejected based solely on an AI score. We have tools and processes in place to test for bias and to review how these tools perform, and we adjust our approach as AI technology and the laws that govern it change.

Your choices

You can ask for human-only review of your application, opt out of AI interview note-taking, request an accommodation, or ask questions about how we use AI. Contact recruiting@circleci.com.  For how we handle your data, including retention, see our Privacy Policy.

jobs.description:
Headquarters: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within United States

Mercury is building a complete finance stack for startups. Since we launched Mercury in 2019, our customer base has grown to over 450,000 startups and small businesses from all around the world. With growth comes the need to ensure our customer experience is top of mind even in the most challenging scenarios.

We’re working to build something like magic for a really wide range of startup businesses. A key piece of the magic we’ve built thus far has been smart, product-driven support, and we’re looking to bring on an operational-focused, thoughtful Support Manager to help us continuously improve our Customer Support experience as we scale quickly.

You’ll join as a manager on our Customer Support team, partnering closely with our existing Customer Support Leadership team to execute the operational function of the team and support the wider strategic vision. You’ll manage your own cohort of specialists who are dedicated to managing customer interactions and operational tasks across key customer workstreams. You’ll work closely with our Voice of the Customer, Customer Trust, Operations, WFM and CX Eng teams to improve our product and general customer-facing processes to provide clear, thoughtful, and accurate support systems to help customers.

You’ll need to understand how our products and internal teams work in detail. Banking* has a lot of moving pieces, so this is harder than it might seem. Finding efficient, elegant solutions for problems stemming from the oft-convoluted U.S. financial system isn’t always easy, but if you’re good at your job, our users will never know it.

Your Role:

  • Lead & Develop: Hire, mentor, and manage a customer support team that excels in product knowledge, user support, and the US banking* system
  • Performance Management & Development: Own team performance management by setting clear goals, tracking key metrics, and driving continuous improvement across your team. Foster a culture of continuous learning and professional growth within your team, providing regular feedback and coaching
  • Process Improvements, AI & Automation: Refine and evolve our support processes, building workflows that drive efficiency and effectiveness across the organization including AI tools and automation to make Support faster and more effective. Take ideas from pilot to production while keeping every workflow within our compliance, privacy, and regulatory standards
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with compliance, engineering, product, and banking partners to resolve complex issues, improve our product based on Customer Support interactions, and implement changes that make for a better customer experience
  • Customer Advocacy: Champion our customers by advocating for their needs with data-driven insights and compelling narratives
  • Hands-On Leadership: Be ready to dive into tickets alongside your team during peak times or critical issues, be a sounding board for escalations, and help wherever the team needs as a leader on the front lines

What we’re looking for:

  • 3+ years of experience leading customer support or other user-facing teams, preferably in high-growth technology companies
  • A collaborative leadership style and comfort sharing ownership of a function with a peer manager
  • Expertise in adding structure for support teams growing quickly
  • Enjoyment in teaching and mentoring others on how to become really skilled at support
  • Previous experience partnering cross-functionally with engineering, product, risk, and compliance teams
  • Comfort navigating data visualization tools (Omni, Metabase, etc.)

The ideal candidate may also have:

jobs.description:
Headquarters: United States, Remote

Our Mission:

6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency.  We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

Our People:

People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging.  Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology.  6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers.  We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career. 

The Opportunity 

We are seeking an Agency Partnerships Director to build and scale 6sense's agency and systems integrator Partner program. You will own the strategy and operating model for these Partners, working with agencies, consultancies, and SIs to create a repeatable source of pipeline, quality implementations, and customer retention. 

You report to the Head of Partnerships & Alliances, and independently set the direction for agency and SI Partnerships, then lead its execution across Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, Product, and Marketing. You set the standards and playbooks that others follow. 

Go-to-market is being rebuilt around agents, and the Partners who design and run that work are choosing their platforms now. Your job is to help make 6sense the GTM intelligence layer they build on. 

What You Will Do 

  • Program strategy and ownership: Define and own the agency and SI Partner strategy, including segmentation, targets, and investment priorities. Bring the Head of Partnerships & Alliances clear recommendations on where to focus and what to stop. 
  • Strategic Partner relationships: Build executive-level relationships with leaders at priority agencies, consultancies, and SIs, and lead joint business plans and quarterly reviews. 
  • Program design and scale: Design the Partner lifecycle, including recruitment, onboarding, tiering, incentives, and program requirements, with playbooks that scale beyond your own direct involvement. 
  • Certification and delivery quality: Define the certification model and quality standards for Partner-delivered work, and work with Enablement and Professional Services to deliver it at scale. 
  • Partner-led delivery model: Partner with Professional Services leadership to define how Partner-led implementations extend capacity rather than compete with it, including coverage and handoff models. 
  • Joint solutions and go-to-market: Shape packaged Partner offerings, including implementation, managed services, and agentic GTM on 6sense, and align Sales and Marketing on how to bring them into deals. 
  • Co-sell operating model: Establish account mapping, deal registration, and rules of engagement with Sales and Customer Success leadership, and report on Partner-sourced and Partner-influenced pipeline to senior leadership. 
  • Product and market influence: Turn Partner insight into roadmap input, especially what agencies and SIs need to run 6sense across multiple clients, and represent 6sense's Partner program in the agency and SI community. 
  • Mentorship and standards: Coach peers and less experienced team members on Partner practices, and set the standards for how Partner work is done. 

Key Outcomes 

  • A scalable program: A documented agency and SI program with clear tiers, playbooks, and operating rhythms, adopted by Sales, Customer Success, and Professional Services. 
  • Partner-driven revenue: Measurable growth in Partner-sourced and Partner-influenced pipeline and closed-won against a program-level target. 
  • Certified delivery capacity: A growing bench of certified Partner practitioners delivering quality implementations at scale. 
  • Sellable joint offerings: Packaged Partner solutions that Sales uses in active deals across segments. 
  • Retention impact: Partner-led customers renewing and expanding. 
  • Market position: 6sense established as a preferred GTM intelligence platform among priority agencies and SIs. 

What You Bring 

Must-haves 

  • 12+ years in SaaS, agency, or consulting environments, including 8+ years in Partnerships, alliances, or channel roles. 
  • Proven record of independently setting Partner strategy and building programs, from planning through pipeline and revenue results. 
  • Executive-level relationships with agency, consultancy, or SI leaders, and experience working with Partners of different sizes, from large agencies and SIs to boutique firms. 
  • A track record of meeting or exceeding a program-level Partner-sourced or Partner-influenced pipeline or revenue target. 
  • Experience designing and running co-sell models with a direct sales team, and influencing Sales, Customer Success, and Services leaders without direct authority. 
  • Sound judgment in ambiguous situations, including the ability to weigh intangibles, make tradeoffs, and recommend a path to senior leaders. 

Nice-to-haves 

  • Martech, adtech, or revenue technology background. 
  • Experience designing Partner certification or enablement programs. 
  • Working knowledge of ABM, intent data, or agentic AI in GTM. 
  • Time on the agency or consultancy side. 
  • An existing network across agencies, GTM consultancies, or SIs. 
  • Experience mentoring or leading other Partner team members. 

Working Profile 

  • Self-starter: Brings structure and follow-through to a program that is still taking shape. 
  • Commercial mindset: Ties every Partnership to pipeline and customer outcomes. 
  • Trusted executive contact: Earns credibility with agency and SI leaders as a peer.
