jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote

Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and publish with confidence. It empowers you to deliver structured and consistent content everywhere: websites, apps, AI search, and beyond.

Legendary brands like Virgin Media O2, Oatly, and TomTom use Storyblok to make a bigger, faster market impact.

 

WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU

You will be joining a growing company where you can contribute to many “firsts”. Plus these benefits:

  • Monthly remote work stipend (home internet costs, electricity). Home office equipment package right at the start (laptop, keyboard, monitor…)
  • Home office equipment upgrade (furniture, ear plugs …) or membership to a local co-working space after your onboarding
  • Sick leave benefit, parental leave and 25 days of annual leave plus your local national holidays
  • Personal development fund for courses, books, conferences, and material
  • The annual international team-building trip, quarterly and monthly online get-togethers
  • As a fully remote company, with work-life balance at its core, you’ll enjoy flexible schedules
  • An international team that loves to have fun at work and works hard together to accomplish shared goals

JOB SUMMARY

Work with Storyblok’s dynamic legal team and play a vital role in our day-to-day operations in the EMEA region. The primary focus of this role is leading SaaS sales contract negotiations—drafting, redlining, and closing enterprise agreements that enable Storyblok’s EMEA sales team to move quickly and confidently. Beyond contracts, your responsibilities span advising on corporate, privacy, employment and labor law, and supporting product and cybersecurity compliance initiatives. You will lead legal projects with autonomy, guide business teams, and collaborate with external counsel as needed. While focused on the EMEA region, you will also support legal initiatives in AMER, contributing to global policies and aligning legal processes across regions. Additionally, you will provide legal training, empower team members to manage day-to-day legal tasks, and support the legal leadership in executing strategic priorities and continuous improvement efforts.

This role requires extensive collaboration with cross-functional teams across the company—with a particular emphasis on the Sales team—as well as Marketing, Partners, Product, People, etc., to provide practical, business-minded legal support . 

 

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

  • Lead the redlining & negotiating process and own SaaS enterprise sales contracts as the primary focus of this role—including MSA, GTC/ToS, NDA, DPA, and other legal agreements—enabling the EMEA sales team to close deals efficiently and with legal confidence  
  • Advise on legal principles relating to data privacy, IP, information security, and corporate risk mitigation
  • Lead the review and negotiate partnership agreements with our partners in EMEA
  • Lead (globally) with review and negotiation of procurement and marketing contracts as needed 
  • Lead HR related projects & provide legal support for certain employment and labor law topics 
  • Draft, review, and maintain company-wide policies in accordance with applicable legal requirements and organisational governance standards
  • Responsible for monitoring and assessing developments in applicable laws and regulations, advising the business on emerging legal risks and required adaptations to agreements, policies, or operational practices
  •  Provide legal advice and lead from a legal side the new product initiatives & feature launches
  • Initiate and lead comprehensive legal training to different teams (e.g. prepare and structure the information for training)
  • Independently lead and own the end-to-end delivery of cross-functional legal projects and improvement initiatives across multiple business regions, ensuring coherent alignment with applicable regulatory frameworks, local counsel, and key business stakeholders
  • Identity and lead the continuous improvement of legal processes, templates, and governance frameworks, ensuring consistency and best practice adoption across the organisation
  • Support the legal team to build and maintain documentation for the whole team
  • Be responsible and contribute across a range of administrative functions and project-based work, adapting to evolving priorities and business needs
  • Provide accurate and concise legal research as needed 
  • Drive and implement regional legal strategies to support the company’s growth and operations



EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • Law Degree and Bar Admission to at least one jurisdiction in Europe
  • 4+ years of experience with a primary focus on drafting, redlining, and negotiating sales contracts. SaaS or fast-paced tech experience providing in-house support to enterprise sales teams is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience partnering directly with Enterprise Sales teams to negotiate customer-facing commercial agreements, including MSAs, DPAs, NDAs, Terms of Service, and related SaaS contracts.
  • Strong understanding of commercial contracting with deep expertise in sales contracts and legal processes
  • Broad and in-depth specialized knowledge of the EU legal framework plus some knowledge of the UK and/or U.S.  law would be strongly preferred

 

QUALIFICATIONS & COMPETENCIES

  • Excellent English language skills
  • Excellent drafting and negotiation skills, with high attention to detail and the ability to manage a high volume of contracts under tight deadlines
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships with internal stakeholders including sales, finance, HR, and product teams
  • Interested in learning fast and participating in a wide variety of legal projects 
  • Skilled in providing concise legal advice to business teams
  • Ability to analyze the needs of different parties quickly and provide a creative solution
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and take ownership of matters end-to-end, while operating effectively within a broader legal team structure
  • Understands and perform in complex legal and business processes
  • Good organizational skills & well structured to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Demonstrates AI literacy, with the ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, decision-making, and quality of work while applying sound judgment and critical thinking.
  • Takes initiative and brings a sense of accountability in the workplace - proactive, resourceful, and solution-oriented
  • Overcomes challenges through teamwork, optimism, and just enough humor to keep things exciting (without compromising professionalism, of course)

MENTAL, PHYSICAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL REQUIREMENTS

Remote (home) work opportunity or funded by Storyblok co-working space

jobs.title: Algolia: Revenue Enablement Manager, Post Sales
jobs.description:
Headquarters: United States Remote

Algolia is the retrieval intelligence layer that turns intent into trusted, decision-grade outcomes. Powering more than 1.7 trillion queries a year for over 18,000 customers with millisecond latency and 99.999% reliability, we are the recognized leader for Search and Product Discovery by top industry analyst firms. The Algolia platform turns a company's products, content, and business rules into data that humans, applications and AI agents can act upon. The result is trusted customer experiences with stronger conversions for measurable business impact.
 

Algolia is looking for a Post-Sales Enablement Manager to strengthen how our Renewals, Customer Success, Solutions and Professional Services, and Support teams serve customers. You will build the product knowledge, technical confidence, and customer-facing skills these teams need across the customer lifecycle. Heavy post-sales hiring is planned for next year, so onboarding is the first priority.

A central part of this role is translating product change into field readiness: helping teams understand how new capabilities work, where they create value, and how to apply that knowledge in customer conversations. You will also help teams make effective use of the tools and resources already available to them through practical guidance, coaching, and reinforcement.

Responsibilities:

  • Build enablement across post-sales. Develop onboarding and ongoing programs for Renewals, CSMs, Solutions and Professional Services, and Support. Establish shared knowledge where it helps, while tailoring learning to each team’s responsibilities.
  • Own the roadmap as a strategic advisor. Take in competing requests from post-sales leaders, prioritize them, and present an FY28 enablement roadmap rather than taking orders. Recognize when a need calls for a process fix, such as a RevOps change, instead of training.
  • Turn product launches into readiness. Partner with Product and technical experts to understand new capabilities, use cases, implementation considerations, and limitations. Create learning experiences, demonstrations, and resources that help teams apply that knowledge with customers.
  • Connect product capabilities to customer value. Work with Product Marketing to equip teams to explain outcomes and differentiation to both business and technical audiences.
  • Develop customer-facing skills. Build programs that improve discovery, success planning, adoption conversations, value reviews, renewal preparation, risk conversations, and issue resolution, as relevant to each team.
  • Help teams use their tools well. Partner with post-sales leaders and Operations to identify where teams need better guidance, skills, or habits to use existing systems effectively. Build practical resources, coaching, and reinforcement that make effective practices part of daily work.
  • Coach and reinforce. Use customer conversations, team feedback, and performance signals to identify skill gaps. Equip managers with ways to coach and reinforce new behaviors after formal training ends.
  • Measure effectiveness. Define clear learning and behavior goals, assess proficiency and adoption in the field, and use relevant customer and business signals to improve programs over time.
  • Apply AI thoughtfully. Use generative AI tools to improve the speed and quality of research, content creation, and knowledge access while checking accuracy and handling customer information responsibly.

Requirements:

  • 3-5 years of experience in post-sales or enablement, including at least 1-2 years of demonstrated success building enablement programs for customer-facing teams in a B2B SaaS or similarly complex technology business.
  • A strong understanding of the post-sales lifecycle and experience supporting multiple functions, such as Customer Success, Renewals, Professional Services, Solutions, or Support.
  • A track record of helping teams apply new product knowledge and customer-facing skills in their day-to-day work, with evidence that your programs changed behavior or improved performance.
  • The technical fluency to learn an API-based product, collaborate credibly with technical experts, and explain how a capability works to both technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • Experience enabling teams to use Gainsight (required), including CTAs, Cockpit, Success Plans, health scores, and playbooks. Salesforce, Gong, and Seismic are nice to have. You understand how these tools support good customer practices; you do not need to have administered Gainsight.
  • Strong instructional design, facilitation, writing, and program management skills. You can turn complex information into clear, useful learning for busy teams.
  • Practical experience using generative AI tools, such as ChatGPT or Claude, to improve the quality or scale of your work.
  • The judgment to prioritize the most valuable learning needs and the ability to build trust across Product, Product Marketing, post-sales leadership, and Operations.

Experience with search, product discovery, ecommerce, developer tools, or enterprise implementations would be especially useful. We value demonstrated results and technical learning ability over a particular degree or fixed career path.

Base Salary Pay Range
$106,000—$128,571 USD

FLEXIBLE WORKPLACE STRATEGY:

Algolia’s flexible workplace model is designed to empower all Algolians to fulfill our mission to power search and discovery with ease. We place an emphasis on an individual’s impact, contribution, and output, over their physical location. Algolia is a high-trust environment and many of our team members have the autonomy to choose where they want to work and when. 

We have a global presence with offices in Paris, NYC, London, Sydney and Bucharest, however we also offer many of our team members the option to work remotely either as fully remote or hybrid-remote employees. jobs.title: Mercury: Corporate Development Lead
jobs.description:
Headquarters: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States

Mercury is building the financial stack ambitious companies use to operate, from banking* to bill pay to forecasting, and everything in between. As we scale, the strategic choices we make about what we build, who we buy, and who we partner with are some of the highest-leverage decisions in the business. To help us make those bets well, we're hiring a Lead on our Corporate Development team. 

This role reports to the Head of Corporate Development. You'll work on M&A, fundraising, investor relations, and strategic projects that shape where Mercury goes next, with a seat at the table on those decisions at a profitable, growth-stage fintech and direct exposure to our CEO, CFO, and executive team. 

This is a function being built, so you'll have the chance to build the corp dev, IR, and strategy muscle at Mercury as we grow, with reps on real deals. We've closed two acquisitions and the M&A roadmap is active. We run Corp Dev as an AI-native, flat, and high-agency team.

What You'll Do:

M&A and Strategic Investments:

  • Own M&A pipeline tracking and target sourcing - keep a living view of strategic and financial opportunities across our roadmap 
  • Partner closely with Product and GTM leadership to surface where M&A or strategic partnerships could accelerate the roadmap - translating product strategy and GTM gaps into a live, prioritized M&A thesis
  • Run Mercury's Market Intel function - maintain a steady flow of competitive and industry intelligence that informs exec decision-making (fintech peers, public comps, private market signals)
  • Run M&A diligence - financial modeling, target evaluation, synergy analysis, working with legal/finance/product on deal execution
  • Drive post-close integration: own the integration plan, run the cross-functional workstreams (Finance, Product, Engineering, People, Legal) and track the deal against the model it was bought on

Investor Relations:

  • Drive preparation of Mercury's Board of Directors materials, alongside the Head of Corp Dev, partnering with the exec team on content and narrative
  • Support investor relations: investor updates, KPI reporting, comps tracking, ad hoc requests from existing investors
  • Build fundraising materials - pitch decks, data room, financial models, investor narrative - alongside the Head of Corp Dev and CFO

You Might Be a Fit If You:

  • Have 5–8 years of relevant experience, with at least 2 years in an in-house Corporate Development seat at a tech company. Investment banking, PE, or growth equity experience before that is welcome but not required
  • Have direct reps on live M&A deals - diligence, modeling and execution
  • Have driven post-close integration on the company side: owned the plan after a deal closed, ran the cross-functional workstreams, and were accountable for whether the deal delivered what the model said
  • Are highly analytical and comfortable with data: you can pull the numbers yourself, find what matters in them, and size the analysis to the decision, from a back-of-envelope estimate to a full model
  • Work with AI every day: you have used AI to build your own workflows and scaled your output
  • Write clearly. Can take a messy strategic question and produce a memo or board-ready slide that drives a decision
  • Are comfortable operating across Product, Engineering, and GTM - you can hold a real conversation with a PM about roadmap tradeoffs and with a sales leader about pipeline gaps, and translate both into corp dev opportunities
  • Have a point of view. Can disagree with senior leaders constructively and back it up with analysis
  • Bonus for having experience ave or demonstrated interest in fintech, in banking/payments business models (interchange, NIM, deposit economics) or B2B SaaS pricing

*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

  • Promote, maintain and enhance our cultural values of humility, passion, inclusion, and leadership

Experience:

Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and publish with confidence. It empowers you to deliver structured and consistent content everywhere: websites, apps, AI search, and beyond.

Legendary brands like Virgin Media O2, Oatly, and TomTom use Storyblok to make a bigger, faster market impact.

 

WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU

You will be joining a growing company where you can contribute to many “firsts”. Plus these benefits:

  • Monthly remote work stipend (home internet costs, electricity). Home office equipment package right at the start (laptop, keyboard, monitor…)
  • Home office equipment upgrade (furniture, ear plugs …) or membership to a local co-working space after your onboarding
  • Sick leave benefit, parental leave and 25 days of annual leave plus your local national holidays
  • Personal development fund for courses, books, conferences, and material
  • The annual international team-building trip, quarterly and monthly online get-togethers
  • As a fully remote company, with work-life balance at its core, you’ll enjoy flexible schedules
  • An international team that loves to have fun at work and works hard together to accomplish shared goals

JOB SUMMARY

The Senior DevOps Engineer II operates beyond individual feature ownership and takes responsibility for major infrastructure subsystems, multi-cycle initiatives, and complex technical challenges that impact multiple teams.

This role works closely with Engineering Managers, software engineering, Security, and fellow infrastructure engineers to drive scalable, reliable, and secure platform solutions and is expected to clarify ambiguous problems, lead technical design efforts, and elevate engineering standards across the Infrastructure pillar.

Success in this role is measured not only by the delivery of high-quality systems but also by the ability to create technical leverage, strengthen reliability, and increase the organization's execution capacity.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

 

  • Be accountable for the technical health, scalability, and long-term sustainability of a defined infrastructure domain or platform area.
  • Lead complex, multi-cycle infrastructure initiatives with end-to-end ownership — from problem framing and architecture design through to measurable delivery and stabilization.
  • Design robust, scalable, and resilient infrastructure architectures and implementation plans that reduce operational risk and improve platform performance.
  • Break down ambiguous or loosely defined infrastructure challenges into clear technical strategies with explicit trade-offs, and communicate these effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Collaborate closely with Engineering Managers, Product, and cross-functional teams to align infrastructure work with business priorities and engineering roadmaps.
  • Improve platform reliability by proactively identifying systemic risks, technical debt, and architectural bottlenecks within the domain and drive remediation before they impact teams or customers.
  • Contribute hands-on to infrastructure code and configuration, delivering high-quality, secure, well-structured, and maintainable work (Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, platform automation).
  • Contribute to the evolution of CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure-as-Code practices, and platform automation standards, pushing for improvements that benefit teams beyond your immediate scope.
  • Apply and advocate for cloud infrastructure best practices (primarily AWS), covering cost efficiency, scalability, security compliance, and operational excellence across your domain.
  • Partner with software engineering, security, and QA teams to ensure infrastructure considerations are embedded early in the development lifecycle and architectural decisions.
  • Drive security posture improvements within your domain using cloud security and vulnerability management tools (such as Aikido), moving the team from reactive remediation toward proactive risk reduction.
  • Improve monitoring, observability, and incident response practices within your domain — contributing to better detection, root cause analysis, and long-term remediation.
  • Raise engineering standards through thoughtful code and design reviews, documentation, and technical guidance.
  • Mentor mid-level and senior engineers across the Infrastructure pillar, supporting their growth toward greater technical ownership.
  • Support production stability by actively participating in debugging, root cause analysis, and long-term remediation efforts.
  • Act as a technical reference point within a defined infrastructure domain, fostering alignment and reducing cross-team friction.
  • Demonstrate AI literacy by actively applying AI tools to improve infrastructure workflows and drive measurable productivity gains across the team.

 

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • 9+ years of relevant experience as a DevOps, Infrastructure, or Site Reliability Engineer, with demonstrated ownership of complex systems or subsystems.
  • Proven experience designing and operating large-scale applications on AWS (GCP or Azure a plus).
  • Strong expertise with Infrastructure-as-Code, primarily Terraform, including reusable modules, state management, and governance patterns.
  • Experience designing secure, scalable CI/CD pipelines and release automation for production-grade systems (e.g. GitHub actions)
  • Experience leading technical initiatives, platform migrations, or large refactors across teams is highly valued.
  • Deep understanding of cloud-native architectures, including compute platforms such as ECS, EKS, Fargate, Lambda or equivalents.
  • Strong Linux fundamentals, networking, and fluency in scripting languages such as Bash, Ruby, Python, or Go.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL operations and familiarity with caching and queueing systems such as Redis or Sidekiq.
  • Strong experience with observability tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, OpenTelemetry, Datadog), SLOs, and incident response practices.
  • Proven ability to apply zero-downtime deployments, autoscaling, and capacity planning in production environments.
  • Strong knowledge of security best practices, including IAM, secrets management, network segmentation, and vulnerability management.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud security and vulnerability management platforms (such as Aikido, Snyk, or Wiz), including triage, remediation workflows, and integration into CI/CD.
  • Familiarity with supporting modern AI/ML services or data-intensive workflows is desirable.
  • Excellent knowledge of how to identify and fix performance bottlenecks across compute, storage, and network layers.
  • AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional (or equivalent) is a strong plus.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to operate effectively in complex, evolving environments.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in a collaborative, remote-first setting.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.

MENTAL, PHYSICAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL REQUIREMENTS

Remote (home) work opportunity or funded by Storyblok co-working space

jobs.title: BeyondTrust: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote Canada | Remote United States

BeyondTrust is a place where you can bring your purpose to life through the work that you do, creating a safer world through our cybersecurity SaaS portfolio.

Our culture of flexibility, trust, and continual learning means you will be recognized for your growth, and for the impact you make on our success. You will be surrounded by people who challenge, support, and inspire you to be the best version of yourself.

The Role

As an Enterprise Customer Success Manager, you are responsible for turning our largest customers’ BeyondTrust investment into outcomes they can measure. You own the path from purchase to outcome: agreeing what success looks like with the customer’s executive sponsors and driving adoption of the solution across their teams so those outcomes are achieved and value is realised. You keep your accounts healthy and identify and mitigate risk early, building the proven value that gives the account team a strong footing to renew and grow every account. You are a trusted advisor to security and IT leadership, helping them get the most from their investment. 

What You’ll Do

  • Value realisation: Agree measurable business outcomes and success criteria with each customer. Baseline them, track progress, and report evidence of value delivered. 
  • Success plans: Build and run outcome-based success plans for every account in your book, covering each stage of the customer journey with clear milestones and owners on both sides. Track progress against the plan and escalate where delivery is off course. 
  • Adoption and time to value: Drive adoption of purchased capability against entitlement, using usage data to find where value is going unrealised. Work with the customer’s teams to improve how they use the product and close the gap early. 
  • Account health and risk management: Own the health of your accounts. Monitor usage, sentiment, engagement and delivery signals to identify risk early and diagnose the cause. Own the remediation plan, collaborating cross-functionally to make sure actions are created with named owners, tracked, and closed on time. Keep risks, actions and progress visible to the account team. 
  • Executive engagement: Lead success reviews with sponsors that cover outcomes achieved, usage, risk and roadmap fit, and build ROI cases the customer can use internally. 
  • Account team partnership: Share health, risk and value insights with Sales and Renewals so they go into renewal and expansion conversations with a clear picture of the account. Flag where realised value or new customer needs point to opportunity, and hand these to the account team to pursue. 
  • Escalations: Lead the cross-functional response to escalated customer issues and manage executive-level escalations to resolution. 
  • Cross-team coordination: Work with Services, Education, Technical Account Management, Support, Solution Engineers, Sales and Renewals so that delivery, technical issues and commercial activity all support the customer’s success plan. 
  • Voice of the customer and advocacy: Surface feedback and feature requests to Product with business context, and develop referenceable customers and case studies. 
  • Product Knowledge: Develop and maintain a strong understanding of BeyondTrust’s solutions, applying product knowledge to guide customers toward successful adoption, value realization and outcomes.   

What You’ll Bring

  • 2+ years in customer success, technical account management or a similar post-sale role, managing enterprise customers.
  • A track record of driving product adoption and demonstrating measurable customer outcomes.
  • Experience building and running success plans and using health scoring and usage data to identify and mitigate account risk.
  • Experience leading success reviews and building credibility with senior stakeholders.
  • Experience managing escalations and de-escalating customer concerns, driving cross-functional actions through to resolution.
  • Ability to manage a portfolio of strategic accounts and prioritise effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including translating technical detail into business value.
  • A proactive approach: anticipating risk and acting before issues escalate.

Nice To Have

  • Cybersecurity experience, ideally privileged access management or identity security and knowledge of BeyondTrust products.
  • Background in customer success, technical customer success, technical presales, technical account management or professional services.
  • Awareness of cybersecurity and software trends.
  • Experience with Salesforce, Gainsight and Microsoft Office.

Better Together

Diversity. Inclusion. They’re more than just words for us. They are the guiding values of how we build our teams, cultivate leaders, and create a culture where people feel connected.

We take care of our employees so they can take care of our customers. Customers who come from all walks of life just like us. We hire incredible people from diverse backgrounds because when we are different together, we are stronger together.

About Us

BeyondTrust is the global identity security leader protecting Paths to Privilege™. Our identity-centric approach goes beyond securing privileges and access, empowering organizations with the most effective solution to manage the entire identity attack surface and neutralize threats, whether from external attacks or insiders.

BeyondTrust is leading the charge in transforming identity security to prevent breaches and limit the blast radius of attacks, while creating a superior customer experience and operational efficiencies. We are trusted by 20,000 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 100, and our global ecosystem of partners.

Learn more at www.beyondtrust.com.

jobs.title: Dropbox: Application Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote - US: Select locations

Role Description

As part of the Product Security Engineering team, you’ll focus on reducing risk at scale by building the security infrastructure, automation, and tooling that empowers engineers to ship secure products with confidence. We work closely with engineering and product teams throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC), embedding secure-by-default practices and delivering scalable solutions.

Product Security Engineers create impact by implementing security tooling, writing custom security rules, and building frameworks that address broad classes of vulnerabilities. In addition to proactive development, we support teams through threat modeling, documentation, and education to uplift security culture across Dropbox.

Our Engineering Career Framework is viewable by anyone outside the company and describes what’s expected for our engineers at each of our career levels. Check out our blog post on this topic and more here.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain security tools, automation, and libraries to enable secure-by-default development across engineering teams.
  • Design and implement custom security rules (e.g., Semgrep, CodeQL) to detect and prevent common and emerging vulnerability patterns.
  • Act as a subject matter expert on application security across web, mobile, and desktop environments.
  • Improve and scale the Secure Development Lifecycle (SDLC) by integrating tools, checks, and processes into engineering workflows.
  • Perform targeted code reviews, and develop follow-up tooling or controls to prevent regressions.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, product, GRC, and AI/ML teams to proactively address security risks, especially in fast-moving and emerging tech areas.

Many teams at Dropbox run Services with on-call rotations, which entails being available for calls during both core and non-core business hours. If a team has an on-call rotation, all engineers on the team are expected to participate in the rotation as part of their employment. Applicants are encouraged to ask for more details of the rotations to which the applicant is applying.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of experience in application security or security engineering roles.
  • Hands-on experience building or using security automation tools to improve developer workflows and product security.
  • Demonstrated ability to work across the SDLC, including supporting and interpreting findings from penetration tests and bug bounty reports.
  • Familiarity with modern tech stacks, including microservices, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native environments.
  • Solid understanding of common vulnerability classes (e.g., injection, XSS, authN/authZ issues) and practical mitigation strategies.
  • Comfortable working in cross-functional environments and supporting multiple product and engineering teams simultaneously.
  • Experience participating in or supporting incident response or security on-call rotations is a plus

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in application security engineering, with a strong focus on security tooling and automation.
  • Demonstrated ability to write and maintain custom security rules and integrate them into developer workflows.
  • Experience with machine learning systems, particularly generative AI, and the ability to support secure development in AI-driven products.
  • Experience developing internal libraries or frameworks that reduce or eliminate entire classes of vulnerabilities.
  • Proficient in software development, with experience contributing production-level code in one or more modern languages.
  • Familiarity with securing diverse application types, including web, mobile, and native platforms.
  • Experience with data security, including tooling for data protection, access control, and encryption.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to build trusted partnerships with cross-functional teams.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

  • Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.
 
Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.
 
Our vision:  A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together. 
 

About the Role:

You'll help build the very AI-powered platform you use every day, with real autonomy over the features you ship. We’re looking for a Group Product Manager to lead Wrike’s Core unit - the product area at the heart of how customers plan, structure, manage, and scale work in Wrike.

In this role, you will lead a unit of five product teams and manage a team of five Product Managers. You will define the vision and strategy for Core Wrike going forward, balancing three critical forces: increasing product power, preserving ease of use, and evolving the experience to be suitable for the AI-native future.

This is a high-impact leadership role for someone who can combine strong product judgment, people leadership, customer empathy, and strategic prioritization. You will help shape the foundation of Wrike’s product experience while developing a team of PMs into stronger strategic product leaders.

Your Impact:

  • Set the Core strategy: Define and evolve the vision, strategy, and priorities for Wrike’s Core unit, ensuring the product remains powerful, scalable, easy to use, and ready for AI agents collaboration as well as for human.
  • Lead a multi-team product area: Manage five Product Managers across five teams, ensuring clarity of ownership, strong decision-making, and consistent product quality across the unit.
  • Prioritize ferociously: Balance customer requests, enterprise needs, technical investments, usability improvements, and long-term strategic bets — with a clear view of what matters most.
  • Enable AI-native R&D: Contribute to building the processes, tooling, and mindsets needed for the R&D organization to scale output and outcomes by 10x with AI-native ways of working.
  • Develop the PM team: Coach, mentor, and grow Product Managers, helping them to achieve the next level.

Your Qualifications:

  • Product leadership experience: Proven experience leading product managers or managing a complex product area with multiple teams and stakeholders.
  • Strong core PM craft and customer-centric mindset: Deep understanding of product discovery, customer validation, roadmap strategy, prioritization, metrics, and product delivery.
  • Enterprise SaaS experience: Strong knowledge of B2B SaaS and enterprise customer needs, including scalability, adoption, usability, configurability, and change management.
  • Strategic prioritization: Ability to make hard trade-offs across incomparable investments, customer escalations, technical complexity, and long-term platform direction.
  • Cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management: Ability to align teams and stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Design, GTM, and executive leadership.
  • People management skills: Experience coaching, mentoring, hiring, developing, and managing performance of product managers.
  • Excellent UX judgment: Ability to balance power and simplicity in complex product experiences.

Standout Qualities:

  • Experience in B2B SaaS enterprise products in collaboration or productivity area
  • Practical understanding of AI-native product development and agentic workflows.
  • Visionary mindset and ability to redefine complex products vision
  • Strong technical fluency and ability to partner effectively with engineering leaders.

Our Work Style:

  • Core product impact: You will shape the foundational Wrike experience used by customers every day to manage work at scale.
  • Strategic complexity: The role requires balancing power, simplicity, customer demand, technical depth, and AI-readiness in one of Wrike’s most important product areas.
  • People leadership scope: You will directly develop a team of five PMs and influence the product culture of a larger R&D unit.
  • AI-native transformation: You will help define how Core Wrike evolves for a future where AI changes how teams create, structure, and manage work.
  • High visibility: Your decisions will influence Wrike’s product direction, customer value, and long-term competitiveness.

What’s Next?

  • Exploratory call with a Recruiter
  • Meeting with the hiring manager - Product Director
  • Panel interview with Product, Engineering, and Design representatives
  • Home task
  • Final interview with the CPO

Your recruitment buddy will be Alexandra Vorobyova, Lead Recruiter.


#LI-AV1

Who Is Wrike and Our Culture

We’re a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow.
 
Hybrid work mode

Wrike is our people, not a place. With 1,000+ employees collaborating across nearly every time zone, we support talent through 10 global hubs — Australia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, France, India, Ireland, Japan, and the United States — offering flexible ways of working that include remote work, hybrid environments, and co-working spaces across many locations.
 
While flexibility looks different across teams and regions, employees located near certain hubs — particularly in Prague (CZ), Nicosia (CY), Bangalore (IN), and Rennes (FR) — are generally expected to collaborate in person around 2–3 days per week, balancing the flexibility of distributed work with opportunities for in-person collaboration and connection.

Our persona 

  Smart: We love what we do, and we’re great at it because this is our domain. Our combined knowledge in this space is unmatched.
  Dedicated: We get up every day focused on helping our customers win. We’re committed to helping our teammates win, too!
  Approachable: We're friendly, easy to get along with, considerate, and helpful. 

Our culture and Values 

Customer-Focused

We care about our customers. We understand the customer journey, experience, and value derived from Wrike. Decision-making and action-taking are done with the customer in mind.

Collaborative

We work as one and win together, each bringing unique strengths that contribute to diversity of thought for better outcomes. Leveraging our own work management platform, we foster an environment of creative collaboration and shared achievement.

Creative

We strive to succeed through continuous innovation. It’s our pursuit of novel concepts that helped us create a market category. We continue to cultivate a workplace that fosters creative thinking as a means of transcending conventional boundaries and empowers us to break new ground to deliver extraordinary work management solutions. 

Committed

We believe in ownership at all levels of the organization, by owning workflows from start to finish. Each member of our team is an integral part of this commitment, establishing work as a platform for personal growth and transformation, as well as collective success and growth.

 
Check out our LinkedIn Life Page, Company culture page, Instagram, Wrike Engineering Team, Medium, Meetup.com, Youtube for a feel for what life is like at Wrike.

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. 

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote

Lithic is the modern card issuing and processing platform empowering ambitious financial companies to build the future of payments.

Our infrastructure powers card programs for 100+ innovative clients, from fintechs reimagining credit and digital banking to platforms transforming disbursements and spend management. Companies like Mercury, Flex, and Novo rely on Lithic's developer-friendly APIs, direct network connections, and flawless reconciliation to launch and scale card programs in weeks, not years.

We're building a future where access to better financial products materially improves people's lives, free from the constraints of 30-year-old mainframes and legacy processors. We're proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Stripes, and Mastercard, along with many others. 

We're a team of 170+ across 26 states and 7 countries, headquartered in New York City. 

Reporting to Sam Pinsak, Privacy’s Product Lead, who oversees both product and marketing, you'll partner closely with your engineering manager, eng lead, and the engineers on your pod, a product designer, and, depending on the work, leads across risk, payment, and dispute ops, compliance, biz ops, and support. The product team is small, senior, and moves fast. This is a hands-on role: you'll own a broad surface and live in the details — writing the specs, pulling the data you need to make a call, staying close to customers, and sitting in planning and grooming with your engineering squad. You're self-sufficient with data day to day and partner with an analyst on the deeper dives, and you lean on AI tooling to do the work of a much bigger team. Every bet ties back to the P&L, scope gets cut hard, and you'll have a short path to the CEO and to real customers.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the roadmap and strategy for a core product surface
  • Own the surface and its year-long roadmap; keep the whole thing moving while going deep where it counts most right now
  • Pick the right problems across that surface and frame them into testable bets with clear outcomes; set the product vision and strategy
  • Act as the default decision-maker for your surface and make cross-area trade-offs; defend your calls under ambiguity at leadership review
  • Drive decisions with data and deep customer + business understanding
  • Own the metrics that roll directly into financial and business outcomes for your surface; know which levers move them and which to pull first to hit a target
  • Reason in contribution-margin and unit-economics terms, not just feature impact; hold a segment-level model of our customers and spearhead the research that resolves high-impact, ambiguous questions

  • Lead the team and work cross-functionally
  • Lead an engineering squad as its product manager, and influence cross-functional teams to re-prioritize toward your roadmap
  • Turn recurring decisions into playbooks the team reuses; push for configurable systems and AI/tooling patterns that lift the whole team, not just you
  • Communicate clearly from the detail level up to the strategic picture, adapting to your audience; mentor other PMs and raise the team's craft bar

What You’ll Bring:

  • Ownership of a product area (or multiple connected areas) end-to-end and set its strategy — not just execution of a roadmap handed to you
  • Demonstrate strong judgment under ambiguity: you pick the right problems, make defensible calls, and know when to walk away from one
  • Fluent in unit economics and how product decisions move the P&L
  • Ability to find the levers that matter in performance data and turn them into a clear story for non-technical audiences
  • Fluent with AI-assisted tools and actively building with them to multiply your own and the team's output
  • Ability to ramp quickly across unfamiliar domains and get to real depth quickly
  • Consumer or D2C product experience; consumer fintech or payments a strong plus, not a requirement

jobs.title: Yubico Inc.: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote US (EST), Germany, London

Meet Yubico

Yubico is a global leader in identity security and creator of the YubiKey, the original hardware-backed passkey. We are publicly traded on Nasdaq Stockholm; our global footprint includes headquarters in Stockholm, Sweden, Silicon Valley, California; and Singapore.

Why Join Our Mission?

At Yubico, we are guided by a shared belief that your work matters. We operate under a cultural philosophy of Speed with Integrity, pushing the boundaries of technology to secure the AI frontier—protecting both human and agentic AI interactions—and leading the transition to post-quantum cryptography. In everything we do, we live by our core values:

  • Battle Friction: We constantly look for new ways to simplify our products, our work, and the user experience.
  • Inspire Higher: We think big, champion the open internet, and strive to do the right thing even when it is difficult.
  • One Team: We are open, responsive, and collaborative, overcoming challenges and celebrating our successes together.

Aligned with our commitment to open standards, we foster a thriving builder ecosystem through the Yubico Developer Program, offering free open-source repositories, libraries, and SDKs to help developers rapidly integrate strong hardware authentication into any application. Through close collaborations with technical partners like Google, Microsoft, and Amazon, as well as newer frontiers like OpenAI, we continue to shape a safer digital world while donating security keys to protect vulnerable communities, journalists, and humanitarian groups worldwide through our Secure it Forward program.

At Yubico, we offer:

Yubico Values: We work to ensure that our employees have an open space to have their voices amplified to create a workplace where everyone feels like they belong. In support of this, our employees have created some pretty cool Employee Resource Groups that foster inclusion, help build community and connection across Yubico. Additionally, Yubico donates YubiKeys to organizations in need all over the world (you can read more about our work here).

Social Connection: Relationships and connectedness matter, and we love spending time with our team! Our virtual workspace keeps us connected day-to-day whether it's through Yubico celebrating wins or our buzzing Slack communities. Check out our Life at Yubico Page on LinkedIn and our awards here.

The Role

Yubico is looking for an experienced and highly collaborative Senior Product Manager to define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Tools, Libraries, and Applications (TLA) that underlie many of Yubico products and services. In this role, you will be a technical leader in our product management team and work closely with builders across a variety of our products  from open source libraries and SDKs which empower other developers to create amazing things with our products, command line tools for managing and using YubiKeys and YubiHSMs, as well as graphical apps for mobile and desktop platforms.

Our team works with authentication protocols like FIDO2/WebAuthn and uses cryptography to implement open standards. You'll have the opportunity to help us showcase our libraries in sample apps, making complex topics easier to use. You will help define and deliver the success of Yubico’s foundational product areas and expand the use of our technology to new and innovative areas that capture the market demand. You will serve as the strategic counterpart to our Senior Director of Engineering for Tools, Libraries & Apps.

This role will own the "what" and "why" behind the enterprise-grade, secured, and reliable software used to build new applications and services that expand the value of Yubico hardware and services. To succeed, you will work closely with other product managers, engineers, solutions engineers, and operations teams to translate complex business and technical requirements into a robust definition for the foundational tools, libraries and applications in our expanding product portfolio

Tasks & Responsibilities

  • Product Strategy & Roadmap Ownership: Define and execute the long-term product vision and roadmap for our foundational tools, libraries, and applications, ensuring tight alignment with overarching business goals and customer needs.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner deeply across Engineering, Product, Operations, and Security teams to design high-impact capabilities that enhance product foundations that underlie efficiency and scalability of our solutions.
  • Customer focus: Meet with customers to understand market demand and outcomes for new products
  • Requirements Definition: Translate complex workflows and software requirements into clear, high-quality product requirement documents (PRDs) and user stories.
  • Technical Partnership & Conflict Resolution: Serve as the strategic unifier in cross-functional technical decisions. Actively synthesize competing priorities between product vision and architectural necessity, ensuring trade-offs are documented, data-backed, and optimized for long-term reliability.
  • Data-driven Insights: Provide data-driven insights on the specific products being managed, including sales and financial performance, year-over-year trends, pipeline, etc.
  • Full life cycle management: Manage the full life-cycle of a product from inception to end of life including: conception, market and requirements gathering, customer validation, creation of high-quality requirements document, management of engineering, marketing preparation, release and end-of-life processes
  • Security & Compliance Management: Collaborate with security and engineering teams to ensure software systems seamlessly integrate with critical cryptographic infrastructure (such as PKI and HSMs) while maintaining Yubico's gold standard of security.

Basic Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Experience: 10+ years of progressively broadening product management experience, with a strong track record of shipping complex, enterprise-class hardware & manufacturing solutions.
  • Domain Expertise: Proven experience in technical product management including development of large-scale internal tools.
  • Leadership & Acumen: Proven ability to act as a constructive challenger to highly technical engineering partners. Strong business and technical acumen with the confidence to debate architectural tradeoffs and act as a constructive challenger in deeply technical environments and manage competing priorities across geographically distributed teams.
  • Communication: Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills to align multi-disciplinary teams toward a unified vision.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Cryptographic Systems: Understanding of cryptographic systems, Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), or Key Management Systems utilizing Hardware Security Modules (HSMs).
  • Analytical Mindset: Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a hands-on approach to diving deep into technical workflows alongside engineering teams.

U.S. benefits designed for your overall well-being:

Health coverage. We’ve got you covered with top of the line health plans, including dental and vision. We pay 100% of your premium and 85% for your family.

Retirement plan. Our retirement plan includes a 401K dollar per dollar match up to 6% with a cap of $6K/year. Immediate vesting.

Wellness reimbursement. We offer $1,200.00 in wellness earnings (prorated based on start date) that you can use on your gym membership, a massage, or your favorite online fitness classes. This is a taxable benefit if you choose to participate.

Learning and development. We encourage your professional growth and offer a yearly development stipend of $3,000 and mentorship program. 

Time off. We offer a total of 15 vacation days plus 10 holidays, and 7 sick days a year.

Paid parental leave. We love welcoming new family members to our YubiTeam! All parents receive 8 weeks of paid leave. Birthing parents receive an additional 8 weeks of paid leave (16 weeks total). 

Commuter Benefits. If you need to commute to the office, we offer commuter benefits. 

Strong mission & company values. We’re a global team on a global mission to make the internet more secure for everyone. We believe that every person’s work matters. That you should always be nice, stay humble, and have fun, and never take yourself too seriously.

jobs.title: Checkr: Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Denver, Colorado, United States; Remote, United States

About Checkr
Checkr is building the data platform to power safe and fair decisions. Over 140,000 companies and millions of people rely on Checkr for AI verification in the moments that matter most: getting a new job, a new place to live, a car ride, childcare, even a date. Customers include Uber, Pennymac, Airbnb, Doordash, and Anthropic.

We’re a team that thrives on solving complex problems with innovative solutions that advance our mission. Checkr is recognized on Forbes Cloud 100 2025 List and is a Y Combinator 2024 Breakthrough Company.

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Solutions Architect, you will lead and execute customer onboarding and technical delivery across Checkr's Guided API and partner integration programs. You will own a high volume of Guided API implementations end-to-end, deploy repeatable Workday integration patterns, and provide technical guidance and optimization support to existing customers. Partnering closely with Customer Success, Customer Support Engineering, Product, and Engineering, you will accelerate time-to-value for our customers and drive scalable platform adoption, fueling Checkr's growth.

What you'll do

  • Lead and execute high-volume Guided API customer implementations end to end, from initial technical kickoff through successful go-live.
  • Deliver Workday and other partner integrations using established, repeatable implementation frameworks and best practices.
  • Provide responsive technical guidance, troubleshooting, and optimization support for existing customers and Customer Success Managers.

About the role

Chime is building a world-class Member Services organization, and the quality of that experience starts long before a member ever reaches an agent. It starts with how well that agent was trained. We're creating this role to raise the bar on two things at once: how consistently training gets delivered across our partner network, and how accountable our BPO partners are for delivering it well. As our Sr. Training Lead, you'll own training governance for Operations and Member Experience, spend real time in the classroom at our vendor sites training new hire agents yourself, and hold our partners' training teams to a higher standard than they've been held to before.

This is a new role on our Learning, Training, and Content Operations team. It's remote, with approximately 30% domestic and international travel to our BPO partner sites.

In this role, you can expect to

  • Own training execution across our lines of business, ensuring BPO trainers are facilitating our programs and content as expected, that agents are receiving the support they need during new hire training, that agents are completing training on time, and provide feedback to the Learning team about opportunities.
  • Guide a group of BPO master trainer contractors to drive training excellence with BPO training teams.
  • Travel to our partner sites roughly 30-40% of the time and train in the room, facilitating new hire classes, delivering Train-the-Trainer ahead of site launches and major releases, and co-facilitating alongside BPO trainers so you see delivery quality firsthand instead of reading about it.
  • Own trainer effectiveness at our BPOs end to end, including trainer certification and recertification, training lead calibration, a real observation and coaching cadence, and the decision about who is cleared to teach a Chime class.
  • Hold our BPO partners accountable for training delivery the way a vendor manager would: build the scorecard, run the governance cadence with partner training leadership, bring the data to business reviews, and drive corrective action plans when a site misses.
  • Measure what matters, using graduation rates (overall and on-time), nesting performance, speed to proficiency, trainer certification rates, and early-tenure quality and performance to find where delivery is breaking down and fix it.
  • Partner closely with Learning, Content, Quality, Workforce Management, Partner Operations, and LOB Operations so that launches land on time and agents are ready on day one.
  • Diagnose the gaps in how we train today and partner to rebuild the standard, bringing a point of view on what good looks like rather than waiting for it to be defined for you.

To thrive in this role, you have

  • 7+ years in training, learning, or talent development within a contact center, BPO, or other high-volume service environment, including hands-on facilitation of new hire classes for frontline agents. You are still comfortable in front of a room.
  • Proven experience managing outsourced or BPO partners and holding them accountable for outcomes, including building performance metrics, governance frameworks, scorecards, and corrective action mechanisms. You've had the hard conversation with a vendor and kept the relationship.

  • Comfort with data, with the ability to evaluate program effectiveness, identify trends across sites and vendors, and translate what you find into business requirements and decisions.
  • The ability to influence without authority across internal stakeholders and external partners at every level, from a trainer on the floor to a partner's site leadership.
  • Willingness to travel domestically and internationally approximately 30-40% of the time. Experience in financial services, fintech, or another regulated environment is a plus.

jobs.title: Netlify: Talent Partner
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote

About the Team

At Netlify, we’re a remote-first, globally distributed company with 120+ employees working across 13 countries around the world. Together, we’re building the platform for building and shipping web apps, with a mission to help anyone bring their ideas to the web.

As a Talent Partner, you’ll play a key role in bringing in the people who will shape Netlify’s next stage of growth. You’ll partner closely with hiring leaders to help them make thoughtful, high-quality hiring decisions and will be deeply embedded in understanding this evolving job market and what makes not only great talent, but folks who align with Netlify’s mission.  With our team, you’ll recruit across a wide variety of teams and talent markets, owning the full recruiting lifecycle and partnering closely with leaders across Sales, Marketing, Engineering, Product, Finance and other functions. Rather than specializing in one area, you’ll build context quickly, learn what great talent looks like across different parts of the business, and help us find and hire exceptional people. 

We’ve already built a number of our own tools and workflows on Netlify to make our day-to-day work better, and we’re continuing to experiment with how AI can create even more leverage. With our team, you’ll be using the same platform you’re helping grow the team behind by shipping tools that improve your own work, experimenting with new ways of working, and contributing to how we continue to evolve how we hire.

What You'll Do

  • Own full-cycle recruiting across a broad mix of functions -  GTM, G&A, and R&D - from intake through accepted offer, without needing a sourcer, coordinator, or ops partner to be effective
  • Run search kickoffs, define and calibrate candidate profiles in partnership with hiring managers, and establish your own search strategy rather than waiting for one to be handed to you
  • Independently develop proactive sourcing approaches for each search and build pipelines of passive talent while continuing to cultivate talent for difficult-to-fill roles and future hiring needs
  • Conduct recruiter screens and develop a clear, evidenced point of view on candidates - sending hiring managers slates with real recommendations
  • Own weekly search meetings with hiring managers: bring funnel data, market feedback, and a perspective on what's working and what isn't; diagnose problems and propose changes rather than just reporting that pipeline is light
  • Act as a trusted talent advisor to hiring managers as you partner with them on their searches,  bringing market insight, recruiting expertise, and thoughtful pushback when it will lead to a stronger hiring decision
  • Partner across the People Team on talent strategy, workforce and organizational planning with HR Business Partners, and with People Operations on scalable solutions and processes.
  • Manage offers and candidate closing end-to-end, while delivering a responsive, thoughtful, and high-touch candidate experience throughout every stage of the process -  including for candidates we ultimately don't hire
  • Use recruiting metrics such as funnel conversion, time to fill, time to hire, sourcing performance, and candidate feedback to identify patterns, inform decisions, and continuously improve how we hire
  • Design and build AI-assisted and vibe-coded recruiting workflows, evaluate them critically, and identify new opportunities to create leverage - without waiting to be assigned an automation project

What You'll Bring

  • Enough full-cycle recruiting reps to operate independently from day one - you've had several years of experience personally run intake, sourced, screened, managed HM relationships, and closed candidates across multiple simultaneous searches
  • A track record of encountering unfamiliar roles or functions and figuring out how to recruit them effectively, rather than defaulting to a narrow specialty
  • A history of sourcing and engaging passive candidates, ideally at companies where the logo wasn't doing most of the recruiting for you - you've had to create interest, not just harvest it
  • Demonstrated ability to partner with hiring managers by running search meetings, interpret and pushing back on feedback, recognizing when calibration is off, and owning the relationship
  • Experience using funnel data to change your behavior - when four candidates get rejected, your instinct is to investigate why, not to source a fifth
  • You can execute quickly across a high volume of searches while maintaining a high bar for quality, balancing speed with the judgment needed to find the right talent for highly specialized roles.
  • Experience working with imperfect infrastructure - you've operated without a dedicated sourcer, coordinator, or mature ops team and made it work
  • A history of noticing broken or inefficient workflows and doing something about them, whether through AI tools, automation, process changes, or creative problem-solving - you've improved something without being told to
  • Strong organization and communication skills, with the ability to keep multiple searches, stakeholders, candidates, and decisions moving in a distributed environment without sacrificing the details or the human experience
  • Proficiency with an ATS and the broader recruiting toolset (we use Greenhouse), and comfort experimenting with AI-powered tools to meaningfully improve recruiting quality or throughput
  • We don't require educational qualifications for the role - we're interested in the experience, judgment, and skills you've developed through your work.

This Role is a Great Fit If

  • You care deeply about the people behind every application and recognize that looking for a new role is a meaningful decision in someone’s life. You lead with empathy, communicate openly, and follow through on what you say you’ll do. Whether someone joins Netlify or not, you want them to feel that their time was respected, they were treated with care, and they had a thoughtful experience with us.
  • You're energized by functional variety. An unfamiliar finance role or a senior engineering search doesn't become "that's not my specialty." You get curious, ask good questions, and figure it out
  • You work well in an environment that resets every few months. Priorities shift, reqs change, and that doesn't throw you -  you reorient and keep moving
  • You can move fluidly between sourcing, candidate conversations, hiring-manager partnership, data, and operational details while keeping communication clear in a remote, async environment
  • You approach recruiting as a strategic partnership with the business by understanding what teams need, bringing a strong recruiting perspective, and helping hiring leaders make decisions that strengthen their teams.
  • You're the kind of recruiter who, when something isn't working, investigates rather than simply escalating. When you're recruiting for something unfamiliar, you ask the right questions, build context quickly, and develop a point of view before moving the search forward
  • You've noticed inefficient systems before and done something about them. You don't need to arrive with a portfolio of automations, but you have a pattern of seeing a problem, getting curious, and experimenting your way to something better

Applying

Not sure you meet 100% of our qualifications? Please apply anyway!

When applying please include: 

A resume or short listing of your job history & skills (link to a LinkedIn profile would be fine). We appreciate a cover letter explaining why you would enjoy working in this role at Netlify to get to know you a bit better, though this is not required and will not impact your application. Our mission is to “build a better web” and that cannot be done without a diversity of skill sets, backgrounds and thoughts. 

Of everything we've ever built at Netlify, we are most proud of our team. Netlify is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are devoted to building a team of people with diverse backgrounds and lifestyles. Driving equality empowers our team, enables us to innovate, and helps us maintain a more inclusive environment. We don’t discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, race, military/veteran status, citizenship, pregnancy status, or any other differences. If we can do anything to provide a better interview, i.e. accommodate a disability, then please let us know by emailing accommodations@netlify.com. 

About Netlify

Netlify is a platform that lets you create, share, and run anything on the web: a website, an app, an agent experience, whatever you can dream up. Use your own tools or ours to build it, collaborate with your team, get it live, and keep it running. Anyone, from people just starting out to seasoned developers, can create pro-level web experiences that really work, really well.

We are a Series D company that has raised over $200M from investors such as Andreessen Horowitz, Kleiner Perkins, EQT, Bessemer, BOND, and Menlo Ventures. As a fully distributed company, we aim to create a company culture where the best idea can come from anywhere and strive to be thoughtful, compassionate, and collaborative in our work. If this sounds like something you’d like to be part of, we’re excited to connect with you!

At Netlify, we are committed to a compensation philosophy that prioritizes fairness and equity, positions our employee compensation competitively in the market, recognizes and rewards performance, and takes a comprehensive approach to our rewards package. We anchor our compensation philosophy on a market-based approach, therefore salary ranges may differ depending on the labor cost in a particular location. The salary provided is in addition to robust benefits and participation in Netlify’s equity plan. Our hiring range for this role is targeted at $97,000 - $150,000 for most US-based locations and $95,000 - $143,000 CAD for most Canada-based locations. Candidates in premium markets should consult with their Talent Acquisition partner regarding location-based ranges, as they may be higher or lower than the average US range listed. The starting pay will be determined based on multiple factors, including expertise and skills, market demands, experience, internal equity, and applicable geographic location. These compensation packages and ranges are subject to change and may be modified in the future. 

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/netlify-talent-partner

jobs.title: Current: Associate, Resource Management

At Current, we're looking for an Associate, Staffing & Talent Operations to support day-to-day resource management, staffing coordination, and talent operations across our multidisciplinary agency.

Reporting to the Director, Staffing & Talent Operations, this person will work closely with Production, Operations, and department leads to manage resource allocations, monitor team capacity, and ensure staffing plans are accurate and up to date.

The ideal candidate has strong hands-on experience with Adobe Workfront, understands resource management within an agency environment, and is comfortable managing multiple staffing priorities. We're looking for someone who is highly organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and able to keep teams aligned on who's working on what.

You'll have the opportunity to work across multiple departments, help shape how we manage staffing and talent, and play an important role in supporting our teams as the agency continues to grow.

jobs.title: Netlify: Staff Software Engineer (Interfaces)
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote

About the Team

As a Staff Software Engineer at Netlify, you'll join a collaborative team that values continuous learning, mutual support, and shared growth. Together, we create tools that help developers build faster, more intuitively, and with greater impact. Our Experience team owns the core product experience at Netlify, which is every way a human or an agent interacts with the platform, from our React-based web application to CLI, MCP, SDK, and API. If users interact with it directly, it's likely ours. We're reimagining how developers experience web development by thoughtfully integrating AI into our workflows - not as a novelty, but as a practical tool that enhances how we build the web.

With our team, you'll help set technical direction for our product area, mentor a highly senior team of engineers, and shape user experiences that serve millions of developers. You'll work closely with Product, Design, and engineering leadership, and partner with teams across the organization to build, iterate, and scale meaningful solutions. You'll have the autonomy to guide what we build and how, and the influence to bring others along with you, all while staying hands-on in the codebase.

We're looking for thoughtful engineers who enjoy owning problems end to end, collaborating across disciplines, and solving complex technical challenges for products that millions of developers rely on every day. AI is a foundational part of how we build, so we value engineers who are excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI-assisted workflows while continuing to apply strong engineering fundamentals. We believe the best engineering happens when talented people are trusted to solve difficult problems together, share what they're learning, and create space for different perspectives to shape better solutions.  With our team, you'll have real ownership from day one - not a tiny slice of a massive codebase. Engineers here are trusted to make decisions, shape technical direction, and move quickly while collaborating closely with Product and Design.

What You'll Do

  • Use your deep expertise in full-stack development (TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, and React) to ship reliable, scalable, performant code across our product suite, and set the patterns that others on the team and across the org follow. 
  • Own the technical direction for our product area, including the web app, CLI, MCP, SDK, API, and docs, by defining architecture and roadmap alongside your manager, Product, and Design, and make tradeoffs explicit so decisions are easy to understand and revisit
  • Lead large, ambiguous projects that span multiple teams from conception to delivery, such as our application rewrite and upcoming CLI rework, writing RFCs, driving alignment, and managing risk and timelines

  • Set the bar for engineering practices - testing, documentation, observability, and performance optimization - and lead how the team pragmatically uses AI tools, sharing what works and what doesn't
  • Turn ambiguity into clear plans, guiding both early-stage prototypes and production-ready applications that directly impact user experience and business metrics
  • Mentor and grow engineers through code reviews, design reviews, pairing, and sponsorship, raising the technical level of the whole team

What You'll Bring
