  • A history of building interfaces developers use directly, such as web apps, CLIs, APIs, SDKs, or other dev tools, and a strong sense of what works well for developers (and, by extension, agents)
  • Passion for building strong user-facing experiences, including working with React and modern frontend architecture and making architectural decisions that hold up as products and teams grow, paired with the backend knowledge to design software well beyond the UI
  • Strong product and design instincts. This isn’t about visual polish - it’s about making thoughtful decisions about how users interact with a product.
  • Strong proficiency with Go and/or Ruby for backend services and API development, with a thoughtful approach to reliability and performance
  • Hands-on experience with React and modern frontend architecture, including making architectural decisions that hold up as products and teams grow
  • Demonstrated ability to raise the technical bar: providing direction to senior and staff-level engineers, distributing ownership, mentoring, shaping standards, and influencing decisions beyond your own team
  • Extensive experience delivering features and services that serve large user bases, including designing for scale and operating systems in production
  • A track record of leading technically complex, cross-team projects from ambiguous problem to shipped outcome, including writing RFCs and building consensus
  • Demonstrated ability to raise the technical bar: mentoring senior and mid-level engineers, shaping standards, and influencing decisions beyond your own team
  • Experience writing high-quality, testable code that's reliable and maintainable over time, and setting that expectation for others
  • Proficiency using and experimenting with AI-assisted development tools, with sound judgment about when and how to apply them and the ability to help others do the same
  • Experience contributing to open-source projects or working in public codebases is a plus
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, especially in asynchronous, remote-first environments, with the ability to explain tradeoffs to engineers, leadership, and non-technical partners
  • Critical thinking abilities and a solution-oriented approach to complex technical challenges, with the judgment to prioritize and say no when needed
  • A collaborative approach to problem-solving with curiosity about how your work supports teammates, users, and broader goals
  • Growth mindset and openness to learning new tools, technologies, and best practices
  • Passion for working in a collaborative environment with diverse teams across distributed locations

This Role is a Great Fit If

  • You're energized by building user-facing products and features that directly impact millions of developers' daily workflows
  • You thrive in collaborative environments, working closely with your team and cross-functionally to turn ideas into reality
  • You enjoy the autonomy and influence of staff-level work - setting technical direction, writing RFCs, and driving decisions across teams while staying connected to the people doing the work
  • You find satisfaction in making other engineers better, whether through mentoring, design reviews, or setting a clear example
  • You see ambiguity as a creative opportunity and can navigate uncertainty to build practical solutions and bring clarity to others
  • You see AI as a multiplier for your skills, not a shortcut, and can articulate where it helps, where it doesn't, and how you use it
  • You're excited by new tools, challenges, and opportunities to grow, even when they feel a little uncomfortable at first
  • You want to work on a fully remote team that believes in autonomy, transparency, and building a better web, together

jobs.title: Vertican: Senior Applied AI Engineer, Document Intelligence
jobs.description:
Headquarters: New Jersey, USA
URL: https://vertican.com

About the role

For 40 years Vertican has buildt software that runs law firms. One year ago we created a new modern AI platform for document automation (processing/extraction/redacting) which our customers have been adopting faster than any product we've ever had. Our suite of AI-enabled products save customers thousands of hours each week by processing high volumes of documents with precision and speed.The AI team is growing and we'd like you to join.

We are hiring an engineer to own the document processing pipelines end to end: design, benchmarking, experimenting with new architectures and tools, threshold required for deploying a new pipeline, etc.

We believe it's important to build our own tooling to help us run, improve, and measure our applications. Therefore, the ideal candidate thinks outside the box on how to not just build the product/pipeline, but also the tooling needed around it.

You will be the first dedicated ML hire on the product taking over from the engineering manager who build the current solution and will work directly with the founding engineering team.

This is a senior, hands-on individual-contributor role, but we are small team and you'll be involved in design, planning, roadmapping, and architectural decisions.

What you will do

Design the pipelines. Own the architecture of the extraction-to-posting pipelines: page classification, field extraction, candidate retrieval, claim matching, confidence gating and the hand-off to human review, etc. Decide where rules end and models begin, and what each stage must guarantee to the next, what the separation of concerns are, etc.

We have different pipelines for different document types and expect that at any given point in time we may have new ones emerge and may consolidate others.

Evaluate new systems before we adopt them. Run structured trials of candidate components and recommend what to keep. Examples include probabilistic record linkage (Splink), Azure AI Content Understanding and Document Intelligence, Azure OpenAI and Foundry-hosted models, and LLM agents with tools. Similarly, test new models with the existing pipeline as they are relased from the frontier labs.

Build the evaluation process. You'll own the process of evaluating false positives, false negatives, errors of ommission, etc, that we ultimately use to determine if we should upgrade the pipeline. 

Ship and operate. Take components from trial to production in our python workers on the cloud, instrument them, watch cost and quota, and diagnose the cases reviewers send back.

Set direction. Work with leadereship on the planing for accuracy, cost improvement, and overall product improvements.

What we are looking for

Required

  • 6+ years building ML or data-intensive systems, at least 3 of them owning a production pipeline whose output people acted on.
  • Solid backend engineering understanding and ideally cloud architecture understanding.
  • Ideally hands-on experience with document understanding: OCR or layout models, field extraction from scanned PDFs, or intelligent document processing products.
  • Experience with entity resolution or record linkage at scale (Splink, Dedupe, Zingg, or your own blocking-and-scoring system) against databases of hundreds of thousands of rows.
  • You have designed an evaluation from scratch: built a labeled ground-truth set, chosen the metrics, and defended a threshold to a non-technical stakeholder.
  • Production experience with LLM APIs, including structured output, tool calling and cost or rate-limit management; you can say when an LLM is the wrong tool.
  • Strong Python and SQL. Comfortable reading Postgres query plans and writing the raw query when the ORM gets in the way.
  • Engineering/Scientist mindset: you are scientific about testing the pipeline and how results are interpeted/presented.

Nice to have

  • Azure AI services (Content Understanding, Document Intelligence, Azure OpenAI, Foundry) or the AWS and GCP equivalents.
  • Financial document processing: checks, remittance advices, lockbox files, payment matching, or accounts receivable automation.
  • Exposure to collections, legal operations or other regulated workflows handling PII.
  • Probabilistic matching theory (Fellegi-Sunter) or active-learning labeling workflows.
  • Experience building human-review tooling or feedback loops that feed back into training and evaluation data.

How we work and what we offer

Small team, direct access to large datasets, weekly planning, daily standup, everyone remote in US timezones.

What we offer:

  • A small team of tight-knit, like-minded people passionate about high quality software
  • Competitive compensation, commensurate with a senior individual-contributor role.
  • Monthly payments in USD

Vertican is an equal opportunity employer. We hire on merit and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status.

Remote, Nationwide – Seeking Instructional Designer

 

Everybody Has A Role To Play In Transforming Healthcare

 

At Vituity you are part of a larger team that is driven by our purpose to improve lives. We are dedicated to transforming healthcare through our culture by working together to tackle healthcare’s most pressing challenges from the inside.

 

Join the Vituity Team. At Vituity we’ve cultivated an environment where passion thrives, and success comes through shared purpose. We were founded in a culture that values team accomplishments more than individual achievements, an approach we call “culture of brilliance.” Together, we leverage our strengths and experiences to make a positive impact in our local communities. We foster this through shared goals and helping our colleagues succeed, and we also understand the importance of recognition, taking the time to show appreciation and gratitude for a job well done.

 

Vituity Locations: Vituity has opportunities at 900 practices across the country, serving 14.5+ million patients a year. With Vituity, if you ever need to move, you can take your job with you.

 

The Opportunity

  • Designs and develops engaging, accessible, learner-centered learning solutions that support enterprise education, organizational initiatives, knowledge transfer, and performance.
  • Conducts learning and performance analyses to identify audience needs, desired performance, root causes, skill gaps, and appropriate learning or performance-support solutions.
  • Develops and customizes learning across modalities, including eLearning, instructor-led and virtual learning, blended programs, job aid, microlearning, simulations, assessments, video, communications, and other performance-support resources.
  • Translates complex content into clear, accurate, engaging, and learner-centered experiences through research and collaboration with SMEs and stakeholders.
  • Develops measurable learning objectives, instructional strategies, storyboards, scripts, prototypes, practice activities, assessments, and evaluation approaches aligned to intended performance outcomes.
  • Applies instructional design and adult-learning principles, learning science, usability, accessibility, content governance, brand/design standards; uses approved AI-enabled tools responsibly to support analysis, design, development, and quality assurance.
  • Conducts quality assurance and user testing to identify and resolve content, accessibility, usability, and functionality issues before implementation.
  • Creates and edits multimedia assets and refreshes, improves, or retires learning assets based on feedback, data, content changes, and business needs.
  • Shares design approaches, tools, lessons learned, and work in progress to support team learning and consistency.
  • Participates in peer reviews and provides timely, constructive, and actionable feedback; seeks and incorporates feedback on their own work.
  • Applies established instructional design standards and contributes recommendations to improve templates, guidance, workflows, and best practices.
  • Independently manages assigned learning projects, including scope, timelines, milestones, stakeholder reviews, approvals, dependencies, risks, and deliverables.
  • Balances multiple projects and competing priorities while maintaining quality, responsiveness, and alignment with agreed-upon requirements.
  • Identifies opportunities to improve learning experiences, development processes, tools, templates, and team workflows.
  • Evaluates and uses approved learning technologies, automation, and AI-enabled tools to improve quality, efficiency, and learner experience.
  • Contributes instructional design and digital-content expertise to pilots, cross-functional projects, technology testing, and improvement initiatives within assigned scope.
  • Partners with SMEs and stakeholders to clarify performance needs, desired outcomes, audience requirements, and project expectations.
  • Recommends appropriate learning, performance support, or non-training solutions based on identified needs and constraints.
  • Provides guidance on learning strategy, modality selection, learner experience, accessibility, and implementation considerations.
  • Communicates recommendations, tradeoffs, progress, risks, and decisions clearly to stakeholders.
  • Builds productive relationships with internal partners and represents Learning & Development professionally.
  • May manage solely, or in partnership with the LMS Administrator, including but not limited to: uploading, testing, updating, maintaining, and retiring courses and curricula in accordance with established standards and processes.
  • Troubleshoots course-level Learning Management System (LMS) issues related to functionality, navigation, tracking, completion, and learner experience; supports testing of Learning Management System (LMS) updates and features and escalate system-level issues to the Learning Management System (LMS) Administrator as appropriate.
  • Partners with the Learning Management System (LMS) Administrator and stakeholders to support learner assignments and course delivery and develops or maintains SOPs and documentation related to instructional design processes and Learning Management System (LMS) interactions as needed.

 

Required Experience and Competencies

  • Bachelor’s degree in instructional design, education, business, communications, or a related field required OR an equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.
  • 2+ years of experience in instructional design or learning content development, with related experience in areas such as technical writing/editing, digital content, multimedia development, or content governance required.
  • Experience applying one or more of the following: adult-learning theory, learning science, instructional design principles, and fit-for-purpose methodologies—such as ADDIE, SAM, and backward design—throughout the learning-development lifecycle required.
  • Experience conducting learning and performance needs analyses; defining measurable learning objectives; recommending appropriate learning or performance-support solutions; and evaluating learning effectiveness required.
  • Experience designing and developing engaging, accessible learning experiences across multiple modalities, including e-learning, instructor-led or virtual instructor-led training, job aids, performance-support resources, and interactive multimedia required.
  • Experience partnering with subject-matter experts and stakeholders to gather requirements, translate complex information into clear and actionable learning content, incorporate feedback, and move projects through review and approval required.
  • Experience managing learning projects from planning through implementation, including scope, timelines, deliverables, stakeholder communication, and competing priorities required.
  • Experience working with a Learning Management System (LMS), including uploading and managing content, supporting course assignments, tracking learner completion, and assisting with course administration required.
  • Proficient in Articulate 360, including Storyline and Rise, with the ability to develop, update, test, and troubleshoot interactive digital learning content required.
  • Working knowledge of – and ability to apply – accessible and inclusive learning-design principles and applicable standards, including captions, alternative text, color contrast, keyboard accessibility, and accessible documents required.
  • Experience applying WCAG and accessibility standards to e-learning and digital learning content preferred.
  • Experience with Adobe Creative Cloud or comparable digital-media editing tools preferred.
  • Experience using learning analytics, learner feedback, assessment data, or performance data to improve learning solutions
  • Experience with learning platform reporting, course lifecycle management, or LMS quality assurance preferred.
  • Portfolio demonstrates learner-centered, accessible learning solutions across more than one modality preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of adult-learning principles, instructional design methodologies, learner-experience design, learning science, and performance-based learning.
  • Ability to analyze business, performance, and learning needs; identify root causes; determine when training is appropriate; and recommend practical learning or performance-support solutions.
  • Ability to translate complex, technical, or specialized information into clear, concise, engaging, and learner-centered content for varied audiences.
  • Ability to develop measurable learning objectives and align instructional strategies, content, practice, assessments, and evaluation methods with desired learning and performance outcomes.
  • Ability to design accessible and inclusive learning experiences by applying applicable accessibility standards and best practices across learning content and digital media.
  • Strong project-management and organizational skills, including managing multiple projects and priorities, establishing timelines, coordinating reviews, identifying risks and dependencies, communicating status, and meeting established deadlines.
  • Strong collaboration, consultation, and communication skills, with the ability to partner effectively with SMEs, stakeholders, and team members; facilitate productive discussions; incorporate feedback; and communicate recommendations clearly.
  • Proficiency with LMS, multimedia, collaboration, documentation, project-management, and productivity tools, including Microsoft 365 applications such as Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook, Teams, and SharePoint.
  • Ability to use learner feedback, assessment results, stakeholder input, and available learning and performance data to evaluate effectiveness and continuously improve learning solutions.
  • Demonstrates the judgement, validation, confidentiality, and human-review practices required for responsible use.
  • Ability to work independently with initiative and sound judgment while contributing to a collaborative team environment through knowledge sharing, peer review, constructive feedback, and continuous improvement.

 

The Community

Even when you are working remotely, you are an important part of the Vituity Community. We offer plenty of opportunities to engage with other Vitans through a variety of virtual meet-and-greets, events and seminars.

  • Monthly wellness events and programs such as yoga, HIIT classes, and more
  • Trainings to help support and advance your professional growth
  • Team building activities such as virtual scavenger hunts and holiday celebrations
  • Flexible work hours
  • Opportunities to attend Vituity community events including LGBTQ+ History, Día de los Muertos Celebration, Money Management/Money Relationship, and more

 

Benefits & Beyond*

Vituity cares about the whole you. With our comprehensive compensation and benefits package, we are mindful of what matters most, and support your needs of today and your plans for the future.

  • Superior health plan options
  • Dental, Vision, HSA/FSA, Life and AD&D coverage, and more
  • Top Tier 401(k) retirement savings plans that offers a $1.20 match for every dollar up to 6%25 plus discretionary profit-sharing contributions (eligible January following 18 months of service)
  • Generous paid time off starting 3-4 weeks’ annually
  • Student Loan Refinancing Discounts
  • Professional and Career Development Program
  • EAP and travel assistance included
  • Wellness program
  • Purpose-driven culture focused on improving the lives of our patients, communities, and employees

 

 

We are excited to share the base salary range for this position is $64,970 - $81,215, exclusive of fringe benefits or potential bonuses. This position is also eligible to participate in our annual corporate Success Sharing bonus program, which is based on the company’s annual performance. If you are hired at Vituity, your final base salary compensation will be determined based on factors such as skills, education, and/or experience. We believe in the importance of pay equity and consider internal equity of our current team members as a part of any final offer. Please speak with a recruiter for more details.

 

We are unified around the common purpose of transforming healthcare to improve lives and we believe everyone has a role to play in that. When we work together across sites and specialties as an integrated healthcare team, we exceed the expectations of our patients and the hospitals and clinics we work in. If you are looking to make a difference, from clinical to corporate, Vituity is the place to do it. Come grow with us.

 

Vituity does not discriminate against any person on the basis of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information (including family medical history), veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law. Vituity is committed to complying with all applicable national, state and local laws pertaining to nondiscrimination and equal opportunity.

Applicants only. No agencies please.

jobs.description:

Join the company that’s building the telemetry infrastructure for the AI era. At Cribl, we partner with IT and Security teams at many of the world’s biggest enterprises, including half of the Fortune 100, to bridge the gap between AI ambition and infrastructure reality. With a global workforce, we’re remote‑first and grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd.

Why You’ll Love This Role

Cribl Detect brings Cribl’s telemetry platform and security expertise together to help customers improve detection coverage, reduce alert noise, and speed investigations—while keeping the flexibility to use the tools they already have. As Director of Security Research, you’ll build and lead a research organization across detection engineering, threat hunting, and AI-driven triage and investigation. You’ll develop the team, set research priorities, and partner with Product and Engineering to shape Cribl Detect. You’ll also publish technical research and collaborate with Cribl’s internal SOC to strengthen Cribl’s defenses.

Based in Israel, this hybrid role works closely with teammates across Israel and the US, with regular overlap with US working hours and periodic travel to the US. The package includes competitive compensation and equity, pension and Keren Hishtalmut contributions subject to local policy, paid time off, a Cibus meal card, and professional development.


As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will…

  • Build and lead the research organization: hire and develop researchers and research leaders, set shared standards, and align priorities with customer needs, emerging threats, and product goals.
  • Own threat-informed detection content and effectiveness by turning threat intelligence into validated rules and hunt packs, maintaining coverage, fidelity, telemetry readiness, and rule health, and delivering timely threat advisories.
  • Guide AI-driven investigations by defining how agents test hypotheses, gather evidence, distinguish malicious from legitimate activity, and escalate uncertainty; partner with Engineering to evaluate accuracy, completeness, and false-negative risk.
  • Lead telemetry and security-tool research: define evidence needs and tool capabilities, study how telemetry collection and transformation affect security outcomes, and guide data requirements and integrations.
  • Shape security methods and evaluation for additional AI-agent workflows, including MITRE mapping, noise tuning, and rule authoring.
  • Build technical credibility through substantive publications, practitioner guides, presentations, and selected public tools, frameworks, or datasets.
  • Partner with Cribl’s internal SOC on detections, threat hunts, investigation methods, and security validation; use operational feedback to improve research and product quality while respecting the SOC’s operational ownership.
  • We are a remote-first company and work happens across many time-zones – you may be required to occasionally perform duties outside your standard working hours.


If You’ve Got It - We Want It

  • 10+ years in security research, detection engineering, threat hunting, or investigation, including 5+ years leading teams and a record of turning research into customer-facing content or product capabilities.
  • Experience hiring and developing researchers, growing technical leaders, and building collaborative teams.
  • Strong understanding of adversary behavior, MITRE ATT&CK, security telemetry, detection validation, and analyst workflows.
  • Experience guiding AI agents across security workflows and evaluating output accuracy, security effectiveness, and appropriate human oversight.
  • Practical knowledge of security tools, APIs, and data limitations, with the ability to review detection logic and investigative methods and validate ideas through queries, scripting, or prototypes.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership and communication skills, including the ability to prioritize research and influence Product, Engineering, customers, and executives.
  • Willingness to travel internationally, including to the US.
  • Bonus: Experience spanning detection engineering and automated investigation, or developing investigative guidance or evaluation datasets for AI agents.
  • Bonus: Experience with cloud attack paths, identity, workload security, or cloud-native telemetry; substantive publications, conference presentations, or open-source security contributions are also valued.
  • Bonus: An open, low-ego communication style and an appreciation for good—or bad—jokes.

Headquarters: Remote, New York, United States, AMER

From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us


Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions. As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

Fivetran + dbt  is seeking a Manager of Security Operations, Incident Detection and Response, to bolster and improve the robustness and security of the platform and the entire enterprise. This people-leadership role is hands-on and execution-focused, requiring deep expertise in security operations, incident detection and response, AI-driven security automation, and securing multi-tenant SaaS environments. You'll build and lead a high-performing team, own the detection and response technology stack, and serve as the accountable leader for incident response across the entire enterprise, ensuring threats are detected, contained, and remediated quickly from endpoint to cloud to production.

This is a full-time remote position based out of the US (EST Time Zone).

Technologies You’ll Use

Crowdstrike, Okta, Google Workspace, Wiz, Open Source, Notion, JIRA

What You’ll Do

  • People Leadership: Lead, mentor, and develop a team of detection and response engineers and analysts. Set clear goals, manage performance, and grow careers while fostering a culture of ownership, curiosity, and urgency.
  • Hiring & Team Building: Recruit, hire, and onboard top security talent. Define team structure, roles, on-call rotations, and hiring plans to scale the team alongside the business.
  • Enterprise Incident Response: Own the incident response program for the entire enterprise, including investigation, containment, eradication, remediation, and post-incident review. Act as incident commander for major security events and coordinate with Legal, Privacy, Communications, and executive leadership.
  • Detection Engineering: Build, optimize, and maintain high-fidelity detections across cloud, identity, endpoint, SaaS, and application layers, using threat-informed approaches such as MITRE ATT&CK to close coverage gaps.
  • AI-Driven Security Operations: Drive the adoption of AI, including LLMs and AI agents, to automate alert triage, enrichment, investigation, and response. Evaluate and integrate AI capabilities to scale the team, and build detections for threats targeting AI systems and AI usage across the enterprise.
  • Multi-Tenant SaaS Security: Design detection and response strategies tailored to a multi-tenant SaaS platform, including tenant isolation, cross-tenant access, and customer data protection. Lead customer-impacting incident response and coordinate customer notifications.
  • Security Technology Ownership: Own the security operations technology stack, including SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, cloud detection and response, and log pipelines. Manage the roadmap, budget, and vendor relationships.
  • Threat Hunting & Intelligence: Lead proactive threat hunting and integrate threat intelligence to identify and mitigate emerging threats before they impact the business.
  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Work directly with engineering, infrastructure, IT, application security, and GRC teams to integrate detection and response practices and remediate risks across build pipelines, runtime environments, and corporate systems.
  • Tooling & Automation: Develop and maintain automation, playbooks, and integrations to streamline security processes and provide self-service security tools to the organization.
  • Security Standards & Metrics: Implement consistent security controls, monitoring, and alerting across the enterprise. Define and report on key metrics such as mean time to detect (MTTD) and mean time to respond (MTTR), and support compliance requirements.
  • Knowledge Sharing: Stay up to date with trends in security operations, incident response, cloud security, and AI security, applying this knowledge to improve the Fivetran platform's security posture.

Skills We’re Looking For

  • Security Operations & Incident Response Expertise: Deep expertise in detecting, investigating, and responding to security incidents, with a track record of leading enterprise-wide incident response.
  • People Management: Proven experience managing, hiring, and developing security teams, including setting priorities, managing performance, and building a strong team culture.
  • Multi-Tenant SaaS Experience: Extensive experience securing and responding to incidents in multi-tenant SaaS environments at scale, with a strong understanding of tenant isolation and customer data protection.
  • AI Proficiency: Hands-on experience applying AI, including LLMs and AI agents, to security operations to automate detection, triage, and response, and a strong understanding of the risks AI introduces.
  • Cloud & Infrastructure Security: Strong experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure), Kubernetes, and containerized environments, including cloud-native logging and detection.
  • Detection & Response Tooling: Proficiency with SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, identity, and cloud detection tools, and experience integrating them into automated workflows.
  • Technology Ownership: Experience owning a security technology roadmap, including tool selection, budgets, and vendor management.
  • Problem-Solving: Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to make sound decisions under pressure in fast-paced environments.
  • Communication: Strong communication skills with the ability to effectively collaborate with and educate engineering teams, and to communicate clearly with executives and customers during incidents.
  • Curiosity & Urgency: Demonstrates strong curiosity, a sense of urgency, and a hands-on approach to diving deep into complex technical problems to drive timely and effective solutions.

jobs.title: BeyondTrust: Front-End Engineer, UX/UI
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote Canada

BeyondTrust is a place where you can bring your purpose to life through the work that you do, creating a safer world through our cybersecurity SaaS portfolio.

Our culture of flexibility, trust, and continual learning means you will be recognized for your growth, and for the impact you make on our success. You will be surrounded by people who challenge, support, and inspire you to be the best version of yourself.

The Role

The Web Development Team, part of Brand, owns beyondtrust.com end to end: a React and Next.js front end backed by an enterprise headless CMS, serving a global cybersecurity audience and the pipeline that runs through it. beyondtrust.com is BeyondTrust's largest go-to-market surface, and this role builds it — the campaign and launch experiences, the shared component system underneath them, and the front-end quality of the whole site.

This is a hands-on, mid-level individual contributor role for an engineer who is strong in React, TypeScript and Next.js, has the visual judgment to make what they build look right without every state being specified, and uses AI tooling as an everyday part of how they work. Direction comes from the team; execution and craft are yours. The role reports to the Sr. Manager, UX/UI & Digital Experience.

What You’ll Do

  • Build the web experiences behind BeyondTrust's launches, campaigns and new product narratives, working from direction set with Brand, Demand Generation and Product Marketing, and turning it into something live quickly.
  • Work hands-on in the shared component library every week: build new components, extend existing ones, and improve what is there through cleaner APIs, better typing and clearer documentation, and help shape where it goes next.
  • Build for front-end performance across the site, including Core Web Vitals.
  • Build and improve the conversion and demo-request journey and the form experience.
  • Build WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility into components and pages from the start, including automated accessibility checks.
  • Write component and end-to-end tests for your own work.
  • When you see a better way to do something — a pattern, an interaction, a page that should work differently — prototype it far enough that the team can react to a working example.
  • Use AI tooling, including Claude and Claude Code, as a core part of how you design, build, test and review, and help shape how the team uses it.
  • Build AI-powered features into the site as the team takes them on, such as assistive and conversational search, and content recommendation and personalization.
  • Follow secure development practices: handle secrets properly, keep dependencies current, validate input at boundaries, and take part in standing security review.

What You’ll Bring

  • 3+ years shipping production React and TypeScript, working in TypeScript strict mode.
  • Solid working knowledge of Next.js App Router, including server versus client components, rendering and caching, and the interest to go deeper.
  • Experience building against a headless CMS or API-driven content, including querying over GraphQL, and building components that hold up when content does something unexpected.
  • Strong CSS, including a utility-first framework, and an eye for layouts that hold together at every breakpoint.
  • Experience working in a shared component library, and opinions about what makes one good to build with.
  • Experience measuring and improving front-end performance.
  • Experience testing your own work with component and end-to-end tests, including accessibility checks.
  • Working knowledge of accessibility implementation: semantics, focus management and keyboard interaction.
  • Good visual judgment and comfort in Figma: able to take design direction and fill in the gaps — spacing, states, responsive behavior — without needing every case specified.
  • Everyday, specific use of AI tooling in your own workflow, with examples you can walk through.
  • Comfort taking a piece of work from brief to shipped in a small team.

Nice To Have

  • Experience with a modern hosting and edge platform, including caching and revalidation, incremental regeneration, and debugging production builds.
  • Experience building marketing and go-to-market web experiences, such as campaigns, launches and landing pages.
  • Experience contributing to the design or evolution of a component library, not just building in one.
  • Experience with Claude, Claude Code or comparable AI-assisted development tooling in a team setting.
  • Experience building LLM-backed features, such as retrieval, prompt design and evaluation.
  • Serverless or edge function work behind a front end, such as form handling, API routes and third-party integrations.
  • Motion and animation implemented in code.
  • Comfort working alongside marketers and other non-engineers: explaining tradeoffs without jargon and working from a brief that is not yet fully specified.
  • B2B SaaS, enterprise or security-industry background.

Better Together

Diversity. Inclusion. They’re more than just words for us. They are the guiding values of how we build our teams, cultivate leaders, and create a culture where people feel connected.

We take care of our employees so they can take care of our customers. Customers who come from all walks of life just like us. We hire incredible people from diverse backgrounds because when we are different together, we are stronger together.

About Us

BeyondTrust is the global identity security leader protecting Paths to Privilege™. Our identity-centric approach goes beyond securing privileges and access, empowering organizations with the most effective solution to manage the entire identity attack surface and neutralize threats, whether from external attacks or insiders.

BeyondTrust is leading the charge in transforming identity security to prevent breaches and limit the blast radius of attacks, while creating a superior customer experience and operational efficiencies. We are trusted by 20,000 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 100, and our global ecosystem of partners.

Learn more at www.beyondtrust.com.

jobs.title: Samsara: Account Executive, Mid Market (Southeast)
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote - US

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

This is a dynamic, high energy role in which you will bring the Internet of Things to mid-sized customers, building Samsara's business and bringing the benefits of sensor data to customers. Typical sales will be $20k to $100k, and involve POCs, multiple stakeholders, managing trials, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to executives and CXOs. 

This role is open for candidates residing in the following US states: West Virginia, Virginia, Kentucky, Tennessee, North Carolina, South Carolina, Georgia, Florida . The role requires travel approximately 25% of the time.

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact. 
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work. 
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before. 

Minimum requirements for this role:

  • 2+ years experience in a full-cycle, closing sales role
  • Experience independently closing new deals larger than $10,000 in annual revenue
  • All candidates must be located in one of the following states: West Virginia, Virginia, Kentucky, Tennessee, North Carolina, South Carolina, Georgia, Florida.

An ideal candidate has:

  • Proven track record of consistent quota achievement
  • Experience selling in the midmarket space - medium to large deals sizes
  • Experience with high-volume cold calling
  • Must demonstrate a growth mindset and a willingness to be collaborative with your teammates and in your selling process
  • SFDC familiarity

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

Annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position is below and depends on your city of residence. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual OTE Salary
$152,000—$190,000 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. Accommodations

Our Commitment to Authenticity

jobs.title: Postscript: Senior Fullstack Engineer, Customer Context

Headquarters: Remote

Postscript is the AI messaging platform trusted by 20,000+ Shopify brands — including Brooklinen, Ruggable, True Classic, and Dr. Squatch. 

With a mission to make SMS your number one revenue driving channel, we built the best-in-class SMS marketing platform and launched revenue-driving AI features not available on any other platform. And we're just getting started. 

Backed by Greylock and Y Combinator, fully remote since 2018.

We are looking for a polyglot Senior Fullstack Engineer to join the Customer Context  team. You’ll help build and scale the foundational services, APIs, and pipelines that power the Postscript product. This role blends strong backend engineering skills with a deep appreciation for data intensive systems, performance, and reliability. You’ll collaborate closely with other software engineers, data engineers, and product to help e-commerce marketers maximize their revenue with best-in-class targeting and context-driven AI.

This is a high-autonomy role for engineers who are energized by ambiguity, take genuine ownership of their work, and bring a strong point of view on how to build things well, without sacrificing speed or pragmatism. AI isn't a nice-to-have here — it's central to how we work. We expect our engineers to be active practitioners of AI-first development: fluent with the latest agentic coding tools, curious about what's emerging, and constantly pushing the boundary of what's possible with AI in their day-to-day craft. If you're the kind of engineer who's already experimenting with new models and tooling before anyone asks you to, you'll feel at home here.

As a senior engineer at Postscript, you’ll no longer be only writing code but orchestrating it. 

This position is fully remote and can be based in the US or Canada.

What You'll Do

  • Take deep ownership of systems and product areas on your team, and become the go-to technical expert for what you own
  • Independently investigate, design, and execute solutions across distributed systems with a high degree of ambiguity
  • Architect, build, and maintain highly available, scalable REST APIs and backend services for internal and external use
  • Drive system decoupling, modularization, and technical debt reduction.. Improve long-term maintainability without blocking near-term delivery
  • Build agentically as your default: leveraging concurrent autonomous agent workflows, owning the output, and keeping a steady queue of aligned work moving
  • Stay at the forefront of emerging AI tooling and practices, bringing new techniques back to the team and helping raise the floor for how Postscript engineers work
  • Contribute to how we think about integrating AI into our systems and workflows. That means not just using AI tools, but helping shape where and how AI creates leverage across the engineering org
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product, data, and go-to-market teams by communicating clearly and proactively in an async-first environment
  • Identify and eliminate single points of failure, improving system resilience and knowledge redundancy across your team
  • Improve how engineering gets done: bring better tools, fix workflow friction, build internal utilities when the leverage compounds

What We're Looking For

  • 6+ years of experience building large-scale data-intensive backend systems and APIs
  • You are an active, daily user of AI coding tools and are using them to maximize your output — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalent — and can speak concretely to how they've changed your output and your workflow
  • Some or all of these languages: Python, Go, Rust, React, and TypeScript
  • You follow the AI tooling landscape closely: new model releases, emerging agentic workflows, and evolving best practices aren't things you catch up on eventually.
  • You think critically about AI output and you know where it accelerates you, where it introduces risk, and how to verify what it produces
  • You are able to context switch quickly across concurrent workstreams
  • Experience working on both 0-to-1 initiatives and complex existing systems, and knowing how to balance building new things with improving what's there
  • You have working knowledge of event-driven distributed systems, Kafka, and familiarity with distributed data processing technologies (Flink/Spark/etc)
  • Experience growing systems under production customer load, ideally from early days to the multi-terabyte stage
  • Experience building and designing high-scale systems AWS with a broad variety of database technologies (RDBMS, OLAP, NoSQL, etc.)

  • Experience with infrastructure as code (eg, Terraform). You are comfortable evaluating and applying your infra changes.
  • Familiarity building and observing applications on AWS & Kubernetes, ideally with Datadog, Signoz, or comparable observability tooling
  • Clear, direct communication. Cross-functional partners and async teams can count on you to surface information proactively
  • Strong instincts for technical tradeoffs informed by both engineering best practices and business priorities

What You'll Love About Us

jobs.title: Forter: Senior Solutions Consultant
jobs.description:
Headquarters: San Francisco, California, United States; United States - Denver; United States - Remote

About the role:

Forter is looking for a passionate, technically-grounded Solutions Consultant to join our Emerging Markets team. This is a market-building role as much as it is a technical sales role: you'll be one of the technical tips of the spear as Forter enters and scales in new markets, responsible not only for winning individual deals but for capturing the market intelligence that tells us where and how to win. As a trusted advisor to our sales organization and a key voice into Product, Risk, Engineering, Marketing, and CS, Solutions Consultants ensure our growth is grounded in strong technical alignment between Forter's AI-powered trust platform and the complex, evolving needs of the world's largest, fastest-growing digital businesses.

Forter Solutions Consultants guide prospects and customers through the technical evaluation of our platform, translating deep AI/ML domain expertise into clear business outcomes. In Emerging Markets specifically, you'll also own the feedback loop that turns field experience into a sharpened go-to-market strategy: surfacing what you're seeing on the ground, forming a point of view on where to prioritize, and helping the business run rapid, repeatable experiments toward revenue outcomes.

We are looking to speak with candidates who bring a strong technical sales background, deep AI/ML fluency, and the presence to operate credibly with both technical and business leadership at large, complex organizations, including in markets where the playbook isn't written yet.

What you’ll be doing:

In this role, you will work on complex, high-stakes opportunities where analysis of a prospect's data, models, and architecture requires deep technical evaluation, and where your on-the-ground observations directly shape how Forter approaches an entire market. You will:

    • Technical Discovery & Solution Design: Lead technical discovery with prospects' data science, engineering, and risk teams to understand their existing models, data infrastructure, and decisioning logic, and design how Forter's platform integrates with and improves upon them
    • AI/ML Credibility & Value Translation: Engage as a domain-credible peer to prospects' AI/ML and data teams, then translate that technical depth into a clear, quantified business impact narrative for executive and business stakeholders
    • Market Data Capture & GTM Intelligence: Systematically capture market and technical discovery data across your Emerging Markets deals (buyer maturity, competitive landscape, technical objections, regulatory nuance, integration patterns) and turn it into an honed point of view on GTM prioritization and feasibility for internal teams
    • Sales Partnership: Partner with Sales Executives to drive account strategy, opportunity qualification, and pipeline generation, owning all technical aspects of the sales cycle: discovery, demos, proof of value, RFP/security responses, and technical closing
    • Executive & Business Stakeholder Engagement: Build trusted relationships across both technical (CTO/CPO org) and business-side stakeholders (Ecommerce teams, revenue business owners), positioning Forter as a strategic partner to the whole business, not just a point solution for IT
    • Cross-Functional Feedback Loops: Serve as a connective layer between the field and internal teams (Product, Risk, Engineering, Marketing, and CS), surfacing prospect and market feedback quickly and repeatably, and helping design experiments that convert field learning into revenue outcomes in a repeatable way
    • Customer Success Handoff: Ensure a clean, well-documented technical handoff to CS/Implementation post-sale, setting new customers up for long-term success
    • Innovation and Improvement: Continuously identify opportunities to improve Forter's platform, tooling, and sales process, and mentor other members of the Solutions Consulting team
    • Personal Training and Development: Stay current on evolving fraud, payments, and AI/ML landscape trends, as well as Forter's expanding product suite

What you’ll need:

    • 8+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role, with 5+ years specifically in pre-sales/solutions consulting, sales engineering, or a similar technical sales capacity at enterprise software companies
    • A strong Data Science and/or Data Analytics background, with hands-on experience building, evaluating, or deploying AI/ML models
    • Demonstrated ability to work directly with AI/ML and data science teams at prospect organizations, able to speak their language, earn technical credibility, and translate model performance and architecture into business impact for less technical stakeholders
    • A track record of selling into large, highly complex organizations, ideally with experience navigating multi-stakeholder, multi-threaded enterprise sales cycles
    • Preferred experience selling into the CTO/CPO organization, as well as engaging directly with business-side personas (Ecommerce teams and the revenue business owners that CTO/CPO orgs ultimately need to support), so that technical evaluation stays tied to commercial outcomes
    • Comfort operating in ambiguity and building structure where none exists, with a genuine curiosity about new and emerging markets and the ability to synthesize scattered market signals into a clear, actionable point of view
    • Excellent presentation, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to move fluidly between deep technical conversations and executive-level business narratives
    • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across Product, Risk, Engineering, Marketing, Customer Success, and Sales to build rapid, repeatable feedback mechanisms between the field and internal teams
    • The ability to travel as needed to support the Emerging Markets territory
    • A Bachelor's degree in a technical or quantitative field (Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Engineering, or related), or equivalent work experience
  • You may also have:
    • Experience in fraud prevention, payments, or e-commerce risk, highly beneficial, though secondary to AI/ML modeling depth and technical sales experience
    • Experience with modern data science tooling and languages (e.g. Python, SQL, R) and ML frameworks
    • Familiarity with real-time decisioning systems, transaction risk scoring, or similar high-throughput, low-latency architectures
    • Understanding of popular sales methodologies/frameworks such as MEDDPICC / Command of the Message
    • Prior experience opening up or scaling a new market or territory for a technology company, including building GTM point of view from limited data

About Us:

Commerce is evolving faster than the systems built to support it. Agentic AI is redrawing how people buy. Customer expectations have a new ceiling. And bad actors are evolving alongside every advancement. 

Forter was built to meet this moment — and stay ahead of it.

We are a human-first, AI-built company. Our technology analyzes patterns across a network of over 2 billion shoppers, delivering identity intelligence across the entire commerce journey — from sign-up to checkout to returns — that protects revenue and unlocks great customer experiences simultaneously. The world's most trusted brands — Nordstrom, Instacart, Priceline, Adobe, ASOS, and eBay among them — rely on Forter to get this right. Since 2013, we've raised $525M from investors including Tiger Global, Bessemer, Sequoia Capital, and Salesforce Ventures, and today we power commerce decisions for nearly 1 million businesses globally. We're more than fraud, payments and orchestration – we make trust a competitive advantage.

When you're surrounded by people like this, doing work that actually matters, it changes what a job can feel like.

Forter was built on a simple but powerful conviction: when AI does its job, humans can do theirs better. That philosophy shapes our products and shapes how we work. AI is core to our workflows — not as a shortcut, but as a force multiplier that gives Forterians the space to focus their energy where human judgment is irreplaceable.

We're a global team of 500+ people, with regional headquarters in New York, Tel Aviv, London, and Singapore, and employee presence across the US, Canada, Germany, France, Japan, China, and Australia. Our teams are cross-functional by design, and the work you do here is visible, consequential, and connected to the outcomes that matter.

You'll have real ownership here and proximity to decisions. And we back that with investment in your growth — RSU offerings, L&D programs built around AI tools, and a culture of recognition rooted in our 4.5 day weeks (aka Forter’s Appreciation Fridays and Sundays). From team outings to local cultural celebrations, we mark the moments that matter — wherever you are in the world. We don't want Forter to be just another job. We want it to be the place you build.

jobs.title: Samsara: Account Executive, Mid-Market - DACH
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote - Germany

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:
Samsara is a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $2.1B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy. This is a seat built for high performers and incredibly driven individuals who want to accelerate their careers. While many in the tech scene are scaling back, our DACH team continued to perform above 100% last year. We are looking for territory owners who want to manage deal cycles from €10k to €300k, selling a complex suite of 15+ products to 8 different personas, including MDs and Finance Directors. If you want to be pushed to your limit and rewarded, this is the place.

Whilst the role can be worked remotely anywhere in Germany or London, UK, there is a need to visit clients in the region as required (typically fortnightly basis).

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role you will:

    • Own your destiny: Operate as a pure revenue leader, responsible for 80-90% net-new logo acquisition through self-sourced pipeline.
    • Get In Early: The DACH Mid-Market is a high-achieving segment in the company. The window to build something significant is open right now. 
    • Sharpen Your Edge: Access elite enablement — Command the Message and MEDDPICC coaching — built to make you a more effective closer.

Minimum Requirements for the role:

  • Winning DNA: Minimum 18 months+ closing experience in an outbound-heavy SaaS environment. You must have a proven history of building your own pipe from scratch.
  • Over-achievement: A track record of hitting and exceeding quota in a competitive, complex environment
  • Strategic Grit: Experience managing multi-stakeholder deal cycles and technical POCs. We value your ability to hunt
  • Native German language speakers

Advantageous:

  • Intellectual Curiosity: You are eager to learn the inner workings of diverse industries, from waste management to food distribution, to better align our technology with their operational pain.
  • A Repeatable Sales Framework: You don’t rely on luck or intuition. You have a structured methodology that delivers success and you understand that consistent, high-quality inputs lead to predictable results.
  • A Data-Minded Approach: You are a student of your own funnel. You understand how to structure your activity—prospecting volume, discovery depth, and multi-threading—to ensure a consistent output and forecast accuracy.
  • Continuous Process Iteration: You possess a relentless drive for self-improvement. You are someone who actively seeks feedback, iterates on their approach, and understands that evolving your tactics is the only way to stay ahead of the market.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

jobs.title: Twilio: Architect
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote - US

Who we are 

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions! 

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Architect on our Data Substrate team

 

About the job

Twilio runs on data, and the platform underneath it is entering a major shift. Open table formats, the convergence of lakes and warehouses, tightening privacy regulation, and AI workloads are all changing what a data platform has to do. We’re hiring an Architect to set our direction through that shift and to make sure the systems we build over the next 3-5 years are the right ones.

 

You’ll own the technical strategy for our data platform, spanning storage, lake and lakehouse architecture, catalog and governance, and privacy-by-design. You’ll work across org boundaries, setting standards that dozens of teams build on and raising the technical bar for the engineers around you.

 

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Own the architecture and multi-year technical strategy for the data platform, including the lake/lakehouse, ClickHouse, Elasticsearch, and governance, and keep them coherent as one platform rather than separate systems. Define where each engine fits (for example, ClickHouse versus open table formats on object storage) and the migration path between them.
  • Make and document the major design decisions (ADRs, RFCs) on storage and open table formats, catalog strategy, compute engines, tenancy, data placement, and build-versus-adopt tradeoffs, with cost and performance at petabyte scale as explicit design constraints.
  • Set the reference architectures for how our core storage and query engines (ClickHouse, Elasticsearch, and lake engines) are deployed, tuned, scaled and operated as shared platforms, including capacity, cost, tenant isolation, and upgrade strategy.
  • Define the reliability model for the platform: availability targets, failure domains, disaster recovery, observability, and incident response patterns that teams can adopt.
  • Build privacy and compliance into the architecture, not onto it. Design deletion and right-to-erasure, retention, data residency, and PII classification so they work across the platform’s storage layers, backups, and derived datasets, including data that arrives from upstream streaming systems.
  • Drive data governance: classification, catalog and metadata, lineage, access control integrated with our authentication and authorization systems, data contracts, quality and integrity standards, and a catalog teams actually use.
  • Review designs and technical direction across the org, and act as the escalation point on hard distributed-systems and performance problems.
  • Mentor principal and senior engineers, and grow architectural judgment across the org, not only within one squad.
  • Partner with product, security, infrastructure and consuming teams to turn business needs into platform roadmaps, and say no or re-sequence when the tradeoffs require it.
  • Track emerging data technologies (such as streaming-first architectures, federated query, and AI-ready data layers) and bring forward the ones worth adopting, with evidence from prototypes or benchmarks.

 

Qualifications 

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

 

Required:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 15+ years of experience in software development or a related field, with at least 8 years in an architecture or senior technical leadership role.
  • Proven track record of architecting and delivering large-scale data platforms and setting their technical strategy, on cloud infrastructure such as AWS, deployed with Kubernetes, Terraform and Helm.
  • Deep expertise in storage and compute for analytical data: columnar and open table formats, lake and lakehouse architecture, partitioning, indexing, query planning, and how the choices affect cost and performance at petabyte scale.
  • Breadth across data storage and retrieval technologies, with hands-on depth in at least two of: analytical/OLAP engines (e.g., ClickHouse), search engines (e.g., ElasticSearch/OpenSearch), and lake or distributed processing engines (e.g., Spark, Trino, Flink). You can reason about when to use each, how they interoperate, and how to migrate between them.
  • Working knowledge of streaming systems (e.g., Kafka) and how they interact with downstream storage.
  • Practical experience designing data governance at scale: data classification, catalog and metadata management, lineage, and access control integrated with authentication and authorization systems.
  • Practical experience implementing privacy and compliance requirements (deletion, retention, residency) across a large, heterogeneous data estate.
  • Proficiency in one or more of Python, Java, and Go.
  • Track record of writing and driving architecture decisions across multiple teams, and of changing the direction of an organization’s technical roadmap through influence rather than authority.
  • Experience elevating engineering standards and mentoring senior engineers across teams.
  • Demonstrated commitment to operational excellence: architecting for high availability, observability and incident response in distributed systems, and being credible when a platform is failing in production.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, including making a complex tradeoff clear to engineers and to senior leadership.

 

Desired:

  • Experience operating one of these engines (e.g., ClickHouse, ElasticSearch) at scale, including replication, sharding, ingestion behavior, and multi-tenant isolation.
  • Experience with catalog and metadata systems (e.g., Unity Catalog, Glue, Polaris, DataHub) and open table format catalog strategy.
  • Experience with a platform migration across domains or ownership models, such as moving from central to domain-owned data.
  • A track record of measurable cost optimization on large data platforms.
  • Networking and network security knowledge.

 

Location

This role will be remote, and based in the United States. 

 

Travel 

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

 

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location

Compensation

*Please note this role is open to candidates outside of California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State. The information below is provided for candidates hired in those locations only.

 

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

  • Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont or Washington D.C. : $211,920 - $264,900. 
  • Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay area): $224,400 - $280,500.
  • Based in the San Francisco Bay area, California: $249,360 - $311,700.

 

This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

 

Application deadline information

Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until 1/4/2027 but may change based on business needs. 

.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.
.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.
.
